title: Peace talks rich in symbolism but fundamental differences between Russia and Ukraine remain
english: Representatives from the United States recently visited Kyiv to hold peace discussions with President Zelensky, marking a highly symbolic effort to address the ongoing conflict. While these meetings were productive, the two sides remain deeply divided over the war's outcome, with Russia demanding territorial concessions and NATO restrictions. President Zelensky continues to reject these terms, maintaining that Ukraine requires firm security guarantees and will not yield its land.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ልዑካን በዩክሬን ጦርነት ላይ ለመወያየት ወደ ኪየቭ በመሄድ ከፕሬዚዳንት ዘለንስኪ ጋር ተገናኝተዋል። ምንም እንኳን ንግግሮቹ አስፈላጊ ቢሆኑም፣ በሩሲያ እና በዩክሬን መካከል ያለው የሀሳብ ልዩነት አሁንም ሰፊ ሆኖ ቀጥሏል። ሩሲያ የዩክሬንን መሬት እና የኔቶ አባልነት ጥያቄ ስትገፋ፣ ፕሬዚዳንት ዘለንስኪ ግን ለሀገራቸው ጠንካራ የጸጥታ ዋስትና እንጂ መሬትን አሳልፎ መስጠትን እንደማይቀበሉ አስታውቀዋል።

Mariin kun mallattoo cimaa kan qabu ta'us, gidduu Raashiyaa fi Yuukreenitti garaagarummaan bu'uuraa ammas itti fufee jira. Raashiyaan lafa Yuukreenii fi miseensummaa Naatoo irratti gaaffii cimaa kan qabdu ta'u, Pireezidaant Zelenskiin garuu wabii nageenyaa malee lafa isaanii akka hin kennine ibsaniiru.

title: Susan Sarandon says she still loses film roles over support for Palestine
english: Oscar-winning actress Susan Sarandon stated at the Venice Film Festival that she is still facing career consequences for her vocal opposition to Israel's military actions in Gaza. Despite a changing landscape of public opinion in the United States, she continues to be denied film roles due to her stance. The actor remains firm in her position despite the professional repercussions.

oromo: Aartistii badhaasa Ooskaar moote Susan Saaraandoon, pheeestivaala fiilmii Veeniis irratti akka dubbatteetti, waraana Israa'el Gazaarra geessiste mormuu isheetiif hojii fiilmii dhabuun ishee itti fufeera. Waayee kana irratti yaanni ummataa Ameerikaa keessatti jijjiiramaa jiraatus, yaada ishee ibsachuu isheetiin kan ka'e qacarriin hojii irratti dhiibbaan godhamaafii jira. Aartistittiin kisaaraa hojii ishee mudate kanaan osoo hin harka kennin, yaada ishee irratti akka jirtu ibsiteetti.

title: Will Israelis re-elect Benjamin Netanyahu?
english: Israel's longest-serving leader, Benjamin Netanyahu, is preparing for an upcoming parliamentary election as his coalition faces a challenging political environment. Having spent recent years focused on military conflicts with Hamas, Hezbollah, and Iran, Netanyahu is now seeing opposition parties pull ahead in national polls. Voters will determine his future in the Knesset this coming month as his long-standing leadership faces a significant test.

oromo: Mummichi ministeeraa Israa'el kan yeroo dheeraaf tajaajilan Benyaamin Neetaanyaahuu, filannoo paarlaamaa dhufu irratti injifachuuf qophaa'aa jiru. Waggoota darban kana keessa waraana Hamas, Hizbullaah fi Iraan irratti xiyyeeffatanii kan turan Neetaanyaahuun, amma qorannoon yaada ummataa akka agarsiisutti paartileen mormituu caalmaa qabu. Filannoon Onkoloolessa 27 gaggeeffamu kun, carraa Neetaanyaahuun aangoo irratti turuuf qaban kan murteessuufi qormaata guddaa ta'a.

title: At least five killed in New Delhi building collapse
english: A building collapse in the Satya Niketan neighborhood of New Delhi has resulted in at least five deaths. Emergency crews successfully rescued nine individuals from the site. Search and recovery operations are currently ongoing to check for anyone else trapped in the debris.
amharic: በኒው ዴሊ ሳትያ ኒኬታን አካባቢ በተከሰተ የህንጻ መፍረስ ቢያንስ አምስት ሰዎች ሕይወታቸው አልፏል። የአደጋ ጊዜ ሠራተኞች ዘጠኝ ሰዎችን ከፍርስራሹ ስር በሕይወት ማውጣት ችለዋል። በህንጻው ፍርስራሽ ውስጥ ተጠልፈው የሚገኙ ሰዎችን ለመፈለግ የተደረገው የነፍስ አድን ስራ አሁንም ቀጥሏል።
oromo: Niiw Deelii naannoo Saatiyaa Niiketaanitti mana jireenyaa tokko diigamuun lubbuun namoota shan darbeera. Hojjettoonni gargaarsa ariifachiisaa namoota sagal diigama keessaa lubbuun baasuu danda'aniiru. Namoota biroo diigama sana keessatti hafan barbaaduuf hojiin furmaata kennuu amma iyyuu itti fufee jira.

title: Abdul El-Sayed uses speech to talk about Muslim faith and American identity
english: Michigan Senate candidate Abdul El-Sayed recently addressed the Muslim American community, emphasizing that Islamic faith and American identity are complementary rather than conflicting. He spoke out against the rise of Islamophobia and criticized the current government's focus on overseas military conflicts instead of domestic issues like infrastructure and the cost of living. El-Sayed is now preparing for a high-stakes election battle against Republican Mike Rogers, with two televised debates scheduled for October.
amharic: የሚቺጋን የሴኔት እጩ አብዱል ኤል-ሳየድ በቅርቡ ለሙስሊም አሜሪካውያን ማህበረሰብ ባደረጉት ንግግር የእስልምና እምነት እና የአሜሪካ ማንነት ተደጋጋፊ እንጂ የሚቃረኑ አለመሆናቸውን ገልጸዋል። በሀገሪቱ እየጨመረ የመጣውን የእስልምና ጥላቻ የተቃወሙት እጩው፣ መንግስት ለሀገር ውስጥ መሠረተ ልማት እና ለኑሮ ውድነት መፍትሄ ከመስጠት ይልቅ በውጭ ሀገራት ወታደራዊ ጣልቃ ገብነት ላይ ትኩረት ማድረጉን ነቅፈዋል። ኤል-ሳየድ በሚቀጥለው ምርጫ ከሪፐብሊካኑ ማይክ ሮጀርስ ጋር ከፍተኛ ፉክክር ይጠብቃቸዋል፤ ሁለቱ ተወዳዳሪዎችም በጥቅምት ወር ሁለት የቴሌቪዥን ክርክሮችን ለማድረግ ተስማምተዋል።
oromo: Kaadhimamaan seeneetiin biyya Michigan Abdul El-Sayed hawaasa Muslimoota Ameerikaatti haasaa taasisaniin, amantiin Islaamaa fi eenyummaan Ameerikaa wal-cimsitoota malee wal-faallessituu miti jechuun ibsaniiru. Jibbaa Islaamummaa irratti xiyyeeffatu balaaleffachuudhaan, mootummaan ammaa dhimmoota biyya keessaa kan akka bu'uuraalee misoomaa fi gatii jireenyaa irratti xiyyeeffachuu mannaa, waraana alaa irratti baasii gochuun isaa dogoggora akka ta'e dubbataniiru. El-Sayed filannoo dhufu irratti morkataa isaanii kan ta'an Mike Rogers wajjin dorgommii cimaa kan eeggatan yoo ta'u, ji'a Onkololeessaa keessa falmii televijiinii lama irratti hirmaachuuf walii galaniiru.

title: Indonesia volcano eruption disrupts hundreds of flights
english: Mount Anak Krakatau in Indonesia recently erupted twice, sending thick volcanic ash into the air. This activity has forced the closure of six airports, leading to the cancellation of hundreds of scheduled flights. Local communities are also facing significant challenges as ash covers public roads and various outdoor spaces.

oromo: Gaarran gubbaa Anak Krakatau kan Indoneesiya keessatti argamu si'a lama kan dho'e yoo ta'u, daaraa cimaa gara samii ol ergeera. Daaraan kun daandiiwwanii fi bakkeewwan uummataa irratti kan haguuge yoo ta'u, jiraattotni naannichaa rakkoo hamaa keessa jiru.

title: Iran turns to land trade routes to counter maritime blockade
english: Iran is shifting its focus to land-based trade routes to bypass maritime blockades and reduce its reliance on shipping. By leveraging its borders with fifteen neighboring countries, the government plans to establish more overland commerce options. Additionally, Iran is working with Oman to launch a new, Iranian-managed international transit corridor near the Strait of Hormuz.

Biyyattiin daangaa biyyoota ollaa kudha shan qabaachuu ishee fayyadamuun, daldala ishee daandii lafaatiin babal'ifachuuf karoorsiteetti. Kana malees, Iraan mootummaa Omaanii wajjin walta'uun, qarqara galaana Hormuziitti karaa daldalaa idil-addunyaa haaraa ofiin bulchitu tokko banuuf walii galteetti.

title: Iran to impose restricted shipping zone near Strait of Hormuz
english: Iran has announced plans to create a restricted shipping zone near the Strait of Hormuz, warning that any vessels entering this area will be placed on a sanctions list. This new zone will extend from the current US naval blockade area into sections of the Persian Gulf. Additionally, Iran and Oman are preparing to finalize updated agreements regarding the management of maritime traffic in the region.

Iddoon kun humna galaana Ameerikaatiin kan daangeeffame ta'ee, hanga bishaan galaana Pershiyaatti kan babal'atu dha. Kana malees, Iraanii fi Omaanni dhimma bulchiinsa daandii galaana naannichaa irratti waliigaltee haarawa mallatteessuuf qophiirra jiru.

title: Adidas faces boycott calls over campaign featuring former Israeli soldier
english: Adidas is facing significant backlash and calls for a boycott after featuring a former Israeli soldier in an advertising campaign for its specialized footwear for amputees. Activists argue that the choice is deeply offensive given that the soldier was wounded during a conflict that has resulted in thousands of Palestinian amputations. Critics view the campaign as a way to normalize Israeli military actions and disregard the ongoing humanitarian crisis in Gaza.
amharic: አዲዳስ ለተቆረጠ እግር ተብሎ በተዘጋጀ ጫማ ማስታወቂያ ላይ የቀድሞ የእስራኤል ወታደርን በማሳየቱ ከፍተኛ ተቃውሞ እና የቦይኮት ጥሪ ገጥሞታል። ተሟጋቾች ይህ ድርጊት በጋዛ ግጭት ሳቢያ በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ፍልስጤማውያን አካላቸውን ባጡበት ወቅት አግባብነት የሌለው እና የሚያስቆጣ መሆኑን ይገልጻሉ። ተቺዎች ይህ ዘመቻ የእስራኤልን ወታደራዊ እርምጃዎች መደበኛ ለማድረግ እና በጋዛ የሚካሄደውን ሰብአዊ ቀውስ ችላ ለማለት የሚደረግ ሙከራ ነው ብለው ያምናሉ።
oromo: Adidas duula beeksisaa kophee miila kutannee keessatti loltuu duraanii Israa'el fayyadamuun isaa mormii cimaa fi dhaadannoo 'boycott' godhachuuf waamicha fidee jira. Qabsaawonni akka jedhanitti, waraana gaazaa keessatti namoonni Palastinii hedduun miila isaanii dhabanitti jiraachuu, beeksisi kun miira namootaa kan tuquu fi xiyyeeffannoo dhabuu dha. Mormitoonni beeksisi kun gochoota waraanaa Israa'el kan idilee fakkeessuuf fi rakkoo namoomaa gaazaa keessatti mul'atu gadi qabee ilaaluu dha jedhanii mormaa jiru.

title: Trump administration appeals again to US Supreme Court over mail-in voting
english: The Trump administration has asked the US Supreme Court to intervene in a legal dispute over new mail-in voting restrictions. This request follows a federal judge's ruling that blocked these rules, citing concerns that they were unconstitutional and could disenfranchise millions of voters. The administration argues that these requirements are merely practical updates, while critics maintain that they represent an illegal federal overreach into state-run elections.
amharic: የዶናልድ ትራምፕ አስተዳደር በፖስታ ለሚደረግ ምርጫ በጣለው አዲስ ገደብ ላይ የፌዴራል ዳኛ ውሳኔን በመቃወም ጉዳዩን ወደ ጠቅላይ ፍርድ ቤት አቅርቧል። ቀደም ሲል አንድ ዳኛ እነዚህ ደንቦች ሕገ-መንግሥታዊ አይደሉም እንዲሁም በሚሊዮን የሚቆጠሩ መራጮችን የመምረጥ መብት ይጋፋሉ በሚል እንዲቆሙ አዘው ነበር። የትራምፕ አስተዳደር እነዚህ ህጎች አስፈላጊ እና ተገቢ ማስተካከያዎች ናቸው ሲል ይከራከራል።
oromo: Mootummaan Donald Traamp dambii filannoo postaan godhamurratti daangaa haaraa kaa'e irratti murtoo abbaa seeraa federaalaa mormuun gara mana murtii olaanaatti iyyateera. Kanaan dura abbaan seeranii tokko dambiin kun bu'uura seeraa kan hin qabneefi mirga namoota miliyoonaan lakka'aman kan sarbu ta'uu ibsuun akka dhaabbatu ajajanii turan. Mootummaan Traamp immoo, dambichi jijjiirama barbaachisaafi sirrii ta'e akka ta'e falma.

title: Why is Argentina reviving the Falklands dispute?
english: Argentina has renewed its long-standing territorial claim over the Falkland Islands, decades after the conflict with Britain first occurred. This move to bring the dispute back into the spotlight is influenced by shifting global politics. Analysts suggest that the current tensions between the United States and Britain may be impacting Argentina's decision to reassert its sovereignty over the islands at this time.
amharic: አርጀንቲና ከብሪታንያ ጋር ጦርነት ካካሄደች ከበርካታ አሥርተ ዓመታት በኋላ በፎክላንድ ደሴቶች ላይ የነበራትን የይገባኛል ጥያቄ ዳግም አንስታለች። ይህ የቆየ ውዝግብ አሁን እንደገና ትኩረት ያገኘው በተለዋዋጭ ዓለም አቀፍ የፖለቲካ ሁኔታዎች ምክንያት ነው። በዩናይትድ ስቴትስ እና በብሪታንያ መካከል ያለው ወቅታዊ አለመግባባት አርጀንቲና በደሴቶቹ ላይ ያላትን የሉዓላዊነት ጥያቄ እንድታራምድ ምክንያት ሊሆን እንደሚችል ተንታኞች ይገልጻሉ።
oromo: Arjantiinaan waggoota hedduu booda biyyattii Britishii waliin qabsoo itti taate, har'as daangaa 'Falkland Islands' irratti gaaffii mirgaa kaasuu jalqabdeetti. Wal-dhabdeen kun yeroo ammaa xiyyeeffannoo kan argate haala siyaasa addunyaa jijjiiramaa jiruun wal qabatee dha. Akka ogeeyyiin jedhanitti, waldhabdeen amma Ameerikaa fi Britishii gidduutti jiru, gaaffii mirgaa Arjantiinaan daangaa kana irratti kaastee jirtu irratti dhiibbaa uumuu akka danda'u ibsaniiru.

title: Witkoff says peace talks have been ‘very meaningful’ in Ukraine
english: US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner have arrived in Kyiv for their first official visit to address the ongoing conflict in Ukraine. Witkoff described their initial discussions regarding potential peace efforts as highly significant. This mission marks a renewed attempt by the United States to find a diplomatic resolution to the war between Russia and Ukraine.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ልዩ ልዑካን ስቲቭ ዊትኮፍ እና ጃሬድ ኩሽነር በዩክሬን እየተካሄደ ያለውን ጦርነት ለመፍታት በሚደረገው ጥረት ለመሳተፍ ወደ ኪየቭ አቅንተዋል። ዊትኮፍ ስለ ሰላም ንግግሮቹ ሲናገሩ፣ የተደረጉት የመጀመሪያ ውይይቶች በጣም ጠቃሚ እንደነበሩ ገልጸዋል። ይህ ጉብኝት አሜሪካ በሩሲያ እና በዩክሬን መካከል ያለውን ጦርነት በዲፕሎማሲያዊ መንገድ ለማቆም ያላትን ቁርጠኝነት የሚያሳይ ነው።
oromo: Ergamonni Amerikaa Steve Witkoff fi Jared Kushner waraana Yukreen keessatti gaggeeffamaa jiru dhaabsisuuf marii jalqabuuf gara Kiyiv imalaniiru. Witkoff mariiwwan jalqabaa taasifaman baay'ee barbaachisaa ta'uu isaanii ibsaniiru. Wixinee kanaan Amerikaan walitti bu'iinsa Raashiyaa fi Yukreen gidduutti uumame karaa nagaatiin xumuruuf carraa haaraa uumaa jirti.

title: Sabalenka through to US Open quarterfinals
english: Aryna Sabalenka defeated Taylor Townsend in straight sets to advance to the US Open quarterfinals in New York. Although Townsend initially challenged the top-ranked player by breaking her serve multiple times, Sabalenka regained control to secure the victory. She will now compete against either Linda Noskova or Marta Kostyuk for a place in the tournament's semifinals.
amharic: አሪና ሳባሌንካ በኒውዮርክ እየተካሄደ በሚገኘው የዩኤስ ኦፕን የቴኒስ ውድድር ቴይለር ታውንሰንድን በማሸነፍ ወደ ሩብ ፍጻሜው አልፋለች። ታውንሰንድ መጀመሪያ ላይ ጠንካራ ተጋጣሚ ብትሆንም ሳባሌንካ ብቃቷን በማስተካከል ጨዋታውን በሁለት ሴቶች ማሸነፍ ችላለች። ሳባሌንካ በግማሽ ፍጻሜው ለመግባት ከሊንዳ ኖስኮቫ ወይም ከማርታ ኮስቲዩክ ጋር ትጫወታለች።
oromo: Aryna Sabalenka taphata US Open Nyuuyorkitti gaggeeffamaa jiru irratti Taylor Townsend injifachuun gara waarfa xumuraatti dabarteetti. Townsend jalqaba irratti morkii cimaa gochuun sagalee koo darbitee turte, garuu Sabalenka of tohattee taphicha injifannoon xumurteetti. Sabalenka amma walakkaa xumuraa dhaqqabuuf Linda Noskova ykn Marta Kostyuk keessaa tokko waliin kan taphattu ta'a.

title: Germany's far-right, pro-Israel AfD sweeps Saxony-Anhalt in historic electoral breakthrough
english: The far-right AfD party achieved a historic victory in Germany's Saxony-Anhalt state election, securing 44.5 percent of the vote and potentially nearing regional power for the first time. The party, which strongly emphasizes pro-Israel positions alongside anti-immigration and anti-Islam stances, significantly outperformed the governing conservative coalition. This outcome has sparked international concern, particularly in France, regarding the political implications of the party's rise.
amharic: የጀርመኑ የቀኝ አክራሪ AfD ፓርቲ በሳክሶኒ-አንሃልት ግዛት ምርጫ 44.5 በመቶ ድምጽ በማግኘት ታሪካዊ ድል ተቀዳጅቷል። ይህ ፓርቲ ከኢሚግሬሽን እና ከእስልምና ተቃራኒ አቋሙ ጎን ለጎን፣ ጠንካራ የእስራኤል ደጋፊ መሆኑ ይታወቃል። የምርጫው ውጤት በጀርመን ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ በናዚ ዘመን ማብቂያ ከተካሄደው ምርጫ በኋላ ለአክራሪው ቡድን የክልል መንግስትን የመምራት እድል ሊከፍት እንደሚችል እየተነገረ ሲሆን፣ ውጤቱም በአውሮፓ በተለይም በፈረንሳይ ስጋት ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Paartiin mirga-jabeessaa AfD jedhamu biyya Jarman, naannoo Saxony-Anhalt keessatti mo'annoo seenaa qabeessa ta'e galmeesseera. Paartiin kun sagalee guutummaa isaa keessaa harka 44.5 argachuudhaan, erga yeroo Naazii darbee as biyyattii keessatti aangoo mootummaa naannoo qabachuuf carraa guddaa argateera. Paartiin kun dhaabbata Israa'el deggaruu fi mormii godaantotaa fi islaamummaa irratti xiyyeeffachuudhaan kan beekamu yoo ta'u, bu'aan kun biyyoota Awurooppaa keessattuu Faransaay biratti yaaddoo guddaa uumeera.

title: Balkans: Israel deepens ties with Bosnian Serb separatists through Banja Luka trade office
english: Israel recently inaugurated a Chamber of Commerce in Banja Luka, a move that strengthens ties with the separatist leadership of Republika Srpska in Bosnia and Herzegovina. This development is seen as part of Israel's broader strategy to expand its influence in the Balkans despite global criticism. The event was highlighted by the presence of Israeli minister Amichai Chikli, reflecting a controversial shift in Israel's diplomatic focus toward entities seeking autonomy from established nations.
amharic: እስራኤል በቦስኒያ እና ሄርዞጎቪና በሚገኘው የሪፐብሊካ ሰርፕስካ የንግድ ቢሮ በመክፈት ከስፓራቲስት መሪዎች ጋር ያላትን ግንኙነት አጠናክራለች። ይህ እርምጃ እስራኤል በአለም አቀፍ ደረጃ እየተገለለች ባለችበት ወቅት በባልካን ቀጠና ያላትን ተፅዕኖ ለመጨመር የምታደርገው ጥረት አካል ተደርጎ ይወሰዳል። የኢስራኤል ሚኒስትር አማቻይ ቺክሊ በምረቃው ላይ መገኘታቸው፣ ሀገሪቱ ከታወቁ መንግስታት ነፃ ለመውጣት ከሚንቀሳቀሱ ቡድኖች ጋር የጠበቀ ግንኙነት ለመፍጠር ያላትን ፍላጎት የሚያሳይ ነው።
oromo: Israa'el gammoojjii Baanjalaa Luukaa keessatti waajjira daldalaa banuudhaan, mootummaa Boosniyaa keessatti kan argamu garee qoodamaa (separatist) Republika Srpska waliin hariiroo cimsiteetti. Tarkaanfiin kun Israa'el addunyaa irraa kophaa ta'aa jirtutti, naannoo Baalkaanii keessatti dhiibbaa ishee babal'isuuf yaalii gochaa jirtu keessaa isa tokko. Ministirri Israa'el Amaachay Chiiklii eebba kana irratti argamuun isaanii, Israa'el mootummoota addunyaan beekamtii qaban irraa adda ba'uuf kanneen yaalan waliin hariiroo uumuuf fedhii qabaachuu ishee kan agarsiisu dha.

title: Death toll from Israeli drone attack in southern Lebanon rises to three
english: A drone strike carried out by Israel near a parking facility in Nabatieh, Lebanon, has resulted in three deaths. The Lebanese Ministry of Health confirmed the casualties following the attack on a vehicle. The incident marks another instance of violence in the ongoing regional conflict.
amharic: በሊባኖስ ናባቲዬ አካባቢ እስራኤል በፈጸመችው የድሮን ጥቃት ሶስት ሰዎች መገደላቸውን የሊባኖስ የጤና ሚኒስቴር አስታውቋል። ጥቃቱ ያነጣጠረው በቆመ መኪና ላይ ነበር። ይህ ክስተት በክልሉ እየተካሄደ ባለው ግጭት የደረሰ ሌላው የሞት አደጋ ነው።
oromo: Humni waraana Israa'el naannoo Nabaatiyaa, biyya Libaanoositti iddoo konkolaataan itti dhaabatu tokkootti ergaa xiyyaara nama hin feeneen (drone) haleellaa raawwateen namoonni sadii du'aniiru. Ministeerri fayyaa Libaanoos haleellaa konkolaataa irratti raawwatame kanaan lubbuun namoota sadii darbuusaa mirkaneesseera. Haleellaan kun walitti bu'iinsa naannichatti adeemsifamaa jiru keessatti kan dabalate dha.

title: Death toll from Israeli attacks on Lebanon climbs to 4,362 despite ceasefire
english: The Lebanese Ministry of Health reports that Israeli military actions have resulted in over 4,300 deaths and 12,000 injuries since early March. Despite international ceasefire agreements implemented in April and June, ongoing bombing and territorial occupation continue to affect the country. Israeli forces currently maintain control over a portion of Lebanese land as a buffer zone.

title: The world is finally watching Palestine. But who gets to narrate its story?
english: Although Palestine did not participate in the 2026 World Cup, the Palestinian flag became a prominent symbol of global solidarity against injustice and colonial oppression throughout the tournament. Despite rising international awareness and public sympathy, Palestinians face a tragic paradox as their physical existence and cultural heritage are being systematically destroyed, threatening their ability to tell their own history. The central challenge now involves reclaiming the power to narrate their story as they endure an ongoing campaign of erasure.

title: Palestinian farmers battle settler sabotage to save Hebron crops, livestock
english: Palestinian farmers in the West Bank are facing constant harassment, threats, and agricultural destruction from nearby Israeli settlers. Despite having their crops ruined by livestock and being restricted by military policies, these families remain determined to protect their ancestral lands. The farmers refuse to abandon their farms, viewing the struggle to maintain their livelihoods as a vital act of resistance.

title: Trump official says ‘there may not be a nuclear agreement’ with Iran
english: US Energy Secretary Chris Wright indicated that a diplomatic nuclear deal with Iran is becoming increasingly unlikely. Instead of seeking an agreement, the US may focus on using military strikes to dismantle Iran's nuclear and missile capabilities. Wright noted that any future negotiations might only be possible if there is a change in Iran's leadership.

english: Barcelona maintained their perfect start to the La Liga season by securing a dominant 5-0 victory against Valencia. title: Iran touts military response as US maintains blockade, hits tankers
english: Tensions have escalated as the US military bombed Iranian oil tankers and maintained a naval blockade, resulting in the sinking or disabling of three vessels. Iranian officials have declared that the period of measured responses is finished and are threatening further aggressive actions against US regional bases.

title: Far-right AfD wins vote in Germany’s Saxony-Anhalt state: Exit polls
english: The far-right Alternative for Germany (AfD) party has achieved a historic victory in the Saxony-Anhalt state election, securing 44.5 percent of the vote. This result makes them the first far-right party to win a German state election since World War II, though they narrowly missed an absolute majority. While the AfD is seeking to lead the government, other mainstream parties have historically refused to form coalitions with them, casting doubt on their ability to officially take power.
amharic: የጀርመኑ የቀኝ አክራሪ የአማራጭ ለጀርመን (AfD) ፓርቲ በሳክሶኒ-አንሃልት ግዛት በተካሄደው ምርጫ 44.5 በመቶ ድምጽ በማግኘት ታሪካዊ ድል ተቀዳጅቷል። ይህም ከሁለተኛው የዓለም ጦርነት ወዲህ በጀርመን በግዛት ደረጃ ምርጫ ያሸነፈ የመጀመሪያው የቀኝ አክራሪ ፓርቲ አድርጎታል። ምንም እንኳን ፓርቲው መንግስት ለመመስረት ቢፈልግም፣ ሌሎች ዋና ዋና የፖለቲካ ፓርቲዎች ከእነሱ ጋር ጥምረት ለመመስረት ፈቃደኛ ባለመሆናቸው ስልጣን ላይ የመውጣት እድላቸው አጠያያቂ ሆኗል።

title: Dozens feared trapped in collapsed building in Delhi
english: A five-story residential building housing students collapsed in Delhi on Sunday, with dozens of people believed to be trapped beneath the debris. Authorities report that at least one person has died and several others have been rescued, while emergency teams continue efforts to locate those still missing. Preliminary reports suggest the collapse may have been caused by unauthorized excavation work in the basement that weakened the structure's foundation.
amharic: በህንድ ዋና ከተማ ዴሊ የዩኒቨርሲቲ ተማሪዎች ይኖሩበት የነበረ ባለ አምስት ፎቅ ህንጻ በመውደሙ በርካታ ሰዎች ፍርስራሹ ስር ተቀብረዋል ተብሎ ተሰግቷል። በደረሰው አደጋ ቢያንስ አንድ ሰው ህይወቱ ሲያልፍ፣ የነፍስ አድን ሰራተኞች የተጎጂዎችን ፍለጋ አጠናክረው ቀጥለዋል። የደረሰው አደጋ መሰረታዊ ምክንያት በህንጻው ምድር ቤት ውስጥ የተካሄደው ህገ-ወጥ የማስፋፊያ ስራ ለህንጻው መሰረት መዳከም ምክንያት መሆኑ ተጠቁሟል።
oromo: Magaalaa Deelii keessatti mana jireenyaa barattootaa kan ta'e fi darbii shan qabu tokko kufuun isaa gabaafameera, namoonni hedduunis diigama jala akka jiran sodaatamaa jira. Balaa kanaan lubbuun nam tokkoo darbuun kan mirkanaa'e yoo ta'u, ogeeyyonni gargaarsa ariifachiisaa namoota miidhamanii fi diigama jala jiran baasuuf carraaqqii gochaa jiru. Qorannoon jalqabaa akka agarsiisutti, balaan kun kan uumame hojiin ijaarsa addaatiif jala darbiirra miidiyaa ykn godaannisa gadi fagoo hojjetamee ture bu'uura mana sanaa dadhabsiisuun akka ta'e dubbatamaa jira.

title: Why potluck parties are making a big comeback in America
english: Potluck parties are regaining popularity across the United States as a way to combat rising loneliness and help neighbors connect with one another. These communal meal events are being encouraged by groups like the America250 Commission to strengthen social bonds and celebrate community spirit. While these gatherings serve as a great starting point for interaction, experts note that consistent effort is needed to build long-term relationships beyond just sharing a meal.
amharic: በአሜሪካ ውስጥ እየጨመረ የመጣውን የብቸኝነት ስሜት ለመቅረፍ እና ጎረቤቶች እንዲተዋወቁ ለማድረግ የጋራ ምግብ ማቅረቢያ ድግሶች ወይም 'ፖትለክ' ዝግጅቶች ተወዳጅ እየሆኑ መጥተዋል። እንደ አሜሪካ250 ኮሚሽን ባሉ ተቋማት የሚደገፉት እነዚህ የጋራ ምግቦች የማህበረሰብ ትስስርን ለማጠናከር ትልቅ ሚና እየተጫወቱ ነው። ምንም እንኳን እነዚህ ዝግጅቶች ለግንኙነት መጀመር ጥሩ ቢሆኑም፣ ጠንካራ ማህበራዊ ግንኙነት ለመፍጠር ከምግብ ውጪ ቀጣይነት ያለው ጥረት እንደሚያስፈልግ ባለሙያዎች ይገልጻሉ።
oromo: Amerikaa keessatti namoonni kophaa ta'uu irraa akka fagaatanii fi ollaan walitti dhufeenya cimaa akka qabaatan gochuuf, qophiin nyaataa waloo (potluck) deebi'ee beekamtii argachaa jira. Dhaabbileen akka 'America250 Commission' qophiilee akkasii jajjabeessuun walitti dhufeenya hawaasummaa cimsuuf hojjechaa jiru. Qophiileen kun wal arguuf carraa gaarii ta'anis, walitti dhufeenyi yeroo dheeraa akka uumamuuf namoonni nyaata boodas walitti dhiheenyaan hojjechuu akka qaban ogeeyyonni ni gorsu.

title: China, Nepal race to find thousands still missing 12 days after floods
english: Search teams in Nepal and China are working desperately to find over 5,500 people still missing after a devastating glacial collapse caused massive flooding. The disaster has resulted in nearly 1,400 confirmed deaths, with rescue efforts heavily hindered by difficult terrain, bad weather, and unstable conditions. Nepal is now seeking international financial support from a climate-focused United Nations fund to help manage the widespread destruction and humanitarian crisis.
amharic: በኔፓል እና በቻይና የድንገተኛ አደጋ ሠራተኞች ከበረዶ ግግር መደርመስ በኋላ በተከሰተው ከፍተኛ ጎርፍ የጠፉ ከ5,500 በላይ ሰዎችን ለማግኘት ከፍተኛ ጥረት እያደረጉ ነው። አደጋው እስካሁን ቢያንስ 1,400 ሰዎችን ለህልፈት የዳረገ ሲሆን፣ የነፍስ አድን ስራው በአስቸጋሪ መልክዓ ምድር፣ በመጥፎ የአየር ንብረት እና በሌሎች መሰናክሎች የተነሳ ተስተጓጉሏል። ኔፓል የደረሰውን ከፍተኛ ውድመት እና ሰብዓዊ ቀውስ ለመቋቋም ከተባበሩት መንግስታት የአየር ንብረት ድጋፍ ፈንድ እርዳታ እየጠየቀች ነው።
oromo: Hojjettoonni gargaarsaa Naayijeeriyaa fi Chaayinaa keessatti balaa cabiinsa cabbii (glacial collapse) booda lolaan uumameen namoota 5,500 olii dhabaman barbaaduuf qabsoo cimaa gochaa jiru. Balaa kanaan lubbuun namoota 1,400 ol darbeera; hojiin barbaachaas lafa ulfaataa, haala qilleensa hamaa fi dhiibbaa biroo irraa kan ka'e rakkoo keessa galeera. Neeppaal miidhaa guddaa geesise kana dandamachuuf gargaarsa maallaqaa dhaabbata mootummoota gamtoomaniitti fayyadamuun gargaarsa gaafachaa jirti.

title: What the US militarisation of Latin America could look like
english: The United States is increasing its military presence in Latin America through the new Americas Counter-Cartel Coalition, which officially partners with 17 nations. While ostensibly aimed at drug trafficking and regional security, critics fear this expansion is actually meant to counter Chinese influence and exert political control. Experts warn that prioritizing military budgets over social programs could lead to greater instability, violence, and the erosion of democratic systems across the region.
amharic: አሜሪካ በአዲሱ የአሜሪካ የፀረ-ካርቴል ጥምረት አማካይነት በላቲን አሜሪካ ያላትን ወታደራዊ መገኘት እያጠናከረች ትገኛለች። ጥምረቱ በዋናነት የአደንዛዥ ዕፅ ዝውውርን ለመቆጣጠር ቢመስልም፣ ተቺዎች ይህ አካሄድ የቻይናን ተጽዕኖ ለመግታት እና የፖለቲካ ቁጥጥር ለማድረግ ያለመ እንደሆነ ይገልጻሉ። ወታደራዊ በጀቶች ለማኅበራዊ አገልግሎቶች ቅድሚያ እንዲሰጡ መደረጉ ለክልሉ አለመረጋጋት፣ ለሁከት እና ለዴሞክራሲ መሸርሸር መንስኤ እንደሚሆን ባለሙያዎች ያስጠነቅቃሉ።
oromo: Amerika gamtaa haaraa 'Americas Counter-Cartel Coalition' jedhamuun Latin Amerika keessatti humna waraanaa ishee babal'isaa jirti. Sochiin kun gurgurtaa qoricha sammuu mancaasu to'achuuf kan fakkaatu ta'us, qeeqtoonni tarkaanfichii dhiibbaa Chaayinaa hir'isuuf fi naannichatti aangoo siyaasaa qabaachuuf akka ta'e dubbatu. Baajata waraanaaf dursa kennuun kun fayyadamtoota hawaasaa irratti miidhaa geessisee, naannichatti wal dhabdee, jeequmsa fi sirna dimokiraasii dadhabsiisuu akka danda'u ogeeyyonni akeekkachiisu.

title: Reform UK says Britain is broken. Birmingham tells another story
english: Reform UK recently held a major conference in Birmingham, a city they often use to frame their political narrative about Britain's supposed decline. Despite the party securing the most seats on the local city council, the result reflects voter fragmentation rather than a widespread endorsement of their platform. The party's success is largely limited to specific, less diverse neighborhoods, and their lack of political allies has left them unable to actually govern the city.
amharic: የሪፎርም ዩኬ ፓርቲ በቅርቡ በበርሚንግሃም ከተማ ትልቅ ስብሰባ በማካሄድ የብሪታንያን ሁኔታ እንደ ውድቀት ለመሳል ሞክሯል። ፓርቲው በከተማው ምክር ቤት አብላጫ መቀመጫዎችን ቢያሸንፍም፣ ይህ ውጤት የሕዝቡን አጠቃላይ ድጋፍ ሳይሆን የፖለቲካ ክፍፍልን የሚያሳይ ነው። የፓርቲው ተፅዕኖ በተወሰኑ አካባቢዎች ላይ ብቻ የተወሰነ ሲሆን፣ አጋር ፓርቲዎች ባለማግኘታቸውም ከተማዋን መምራት አልቻሉም።
oromo: Paartiin 'Reform UK' jedhamu magaala Birmiinghaamitti walgahii guddaa gaggeessuun, haala biyyattii akka kufaatiitti ibsuuf yaalii godheera. Paartiin kun mana maree magaattii teessoo baay'ee injifatee illee, bu'aan kun deeggarsa bal'aa osoo hin taane, hiramaa siyaasaa kan agarsiisuudha. Milkaa'inni paartichaa naannolee murtaa'aniin qofa kan daangeffame yoo ta'u, michoota siyaasaa dhabuusaatiin magaattii bulchuu hin dandeenye.

title: How significant are the Yemeni government’s military gains against Houthis?
english: Yemeni government forces have recently recaptured key territories in Hodeidah and Taiz provinces, signaling an intensification of the ongoing conflict. While these tactical advances are notable, they do not currently represent a turning point in the war, as the Houthi rebels maintain control over major cities including the capital. The renewed fighting near vital shipping routes has heightened international concerns about a potential return to large-scale warfare.
amharic: የየመን የመንግስት ኃይሎች በቅርቡ በሆዴይዳ እና በታኢዝ ግዛቶች ውስጥ ወሳኝ ቦታዎችን መልሰው በመቆጣጠራቸው በግጭቱ መጠናከር ላይ ይገኛሉ። እነዚህ ወታደራዊ እርምጃዎች አስፈላጊ ቢሆኑም፣ አማፂ ቡድኑ ዋና ከተማዋን ጨምሮ በበርካታ ከተሞች ላይ ቁጥጥሩን ስለቀጠለ በጦርነቱ ላይ ትልቅ ለውጥ አላመጡም። በስትራቴጂያዊ የባህር መስመሮች አቅራቢያ እየተካሄደ ያለው ተፋላሚነት ወደ ሙሉ ጦርነት ሊያመራ ይችላል የሚል ስጋት ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Humnoonni mootummaa Yaman naannolee Hodeeydaa fi Ta'iiz keessatti bakkeewwan tarsiimoo ta'an to'annaa isaanii jala deebisuun wal waraansi kun daran akka hammaatu taasiseera. Injifannoon kun kan ibsamu ta'us, gareen Huutii magaala gurguddoo fi magaala guddoo to'annaa isaanii jala waan qabaniif, waraanichi ammaaf xumura irra hin geenye. Wal waraansi kun karaalee daldala galaanaa idil-addunyaa irratti akka hammaatu yaaddoo uumeera.

title: Minority Protection is Ethiopia’s Federal Test
english: Ethiopia must strengthen constitutional protections for minority groups to ensure fair representation and prevent the dominance of any single ethnic or religious faction. The author suggests implementing safeguards such as a federal veto mechanism for smaller regions and ensuring equal institutional representation regardless of demographic size. By addressing past historical grievances and adopting inclusive national symbols, the country can foster genuine reconciliation and long-term unity.
amharic: ኢትዮጵያ የየትኛውንም ብሔር ወይም ቡድን የበላይነት ለመከላከል እና ፍትሃዊ ውክልናን ለማረጋገጥ ለቀጣናዊና አናሳ ማህበረሰቦች የሚሰጠውን የሕገ መንግሥት ጥበቃ ማጠናከር ይኖርባታል። የጽሁፉ ደራሲ አነስተኛ ክልሎች ውሳኔዎችን የመሻር መብት እንዲኖራቸው እና የህዝብ ብዛት ሳይለይ በፌዴራል ተቋማት ውስጥ እኩል ውክልና እንዲኖር ሀሳብ ያቀርባል። ይህ ሂደት ያለፉ ታሪካዊ ቅሬታዎችን በመፍታት እና ሁሉን አቀፍ ብሄራዊ ምልክቶችን በመጠቀም ዘላቂ ሰላምን ለመፍጠር ይረዳል።
oromo: Itoophiyaan garee tokko qofa aangoo irra jiraachuun gareewwan biroo akka hin miine gochuuf, mirga namoota muraasaa eeguu fi walqixxummaa mirkaneessuu qabdi. Barreessaan kun bulchiinsa federaalaa keessatti naannoowwan xixiqqoo humna mormii (veto) akka qabaatan fi bakka bu'iinsi dhaabbilee federaalaa lakkoofsa ummataa osoo hin taane walqixxummaa irratti akka hundaa'u gaafata. Jijjiirama kanaan, Itoophiyaan seenaa darbe irraa barachuun mallattoolee waloo hundaaf mijataa ta'an uumtee tokkummaa cimaa ijaaruu dandeessi.

title: Can you guess the real size of each country on the new world map?
english: The United Nations recently voted to promote the Equal Earth map projection, which accurately depicts the true size of countries, as an alternative to the outdated Mercator map. The Mercator projection has long distorted world views by making countries near the equator appear much smaller than they actually are compared to northern nations. While the U.S. opposed the measure as unnecessary, the initiative aims to correct global perceptions by encouraging schools and tech companies to adopt more realistic mapping standards.
amharic: የተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት የአገሮችን ትክክለኛ መጠን የሚያሳይ እና 'Equal Earth' የሚል ስያሜ የተሰጠውን የአለም ካርታ አሰራርን እንዲጠቀም የሚያበረታታ ውሳኔ አስተላልፏል። አሁን በብዛት ጥቅም ላይ ያለው የሜርኬተር ካርታ፣ በአለም ወገብ አካባቢ የሚገኙ አገሮችን መጠናቸውን በማሳነስ እና በሰሜን የሚገኙትን በማሳደግ የተሳሳተ ግንዛቤ ሲፈጥር ቆይቷል። አሜሪካ ይህንን ውሳኔ ቢቃወሙትም፣ ዓላማው ትምህርት ቤቶችና የቴክኖሎጂ ተቋማት ይበልጥ ትክክለኛ የሆኑ ካርታዎችን እንዲከተሉ ለማድረግ ነው።

Ameerikaan mormii ishee yoo ibsituus, kaayyoon kun mana barnootaa fi dhaabbilee teknolojiitiin kaartaa sirrii ta'e akka fayyadaman jajjabeessuudha.

title: Photos: Gaza holds funeral for 100 Palestinians recovered from rubble
english: A large crowd of Palestinians gathered in Gaza City's Zeitoun neighborhood to hold a mass funeral for 100 people whose remains were recently recovered from destroyed homes. These victims were killed during Israeli airstrikes approximately two and a half years ago. This event is part of ongoing recovery efforts, as officials continue to uncover hundreds of bodies from various sites across the region.

oromo: Ummanni Paalastayinii magaalaa Gaazaa naannoo Zeitounitti, reeffa namoota 100 mana diigame jalaa baafameef sirna awwaalchaa gamtaa gaggeessaniiru. Bakkeewwan adda addaatti hojiin reeffa barbaaduu itti fufee waan jiruuf, namoonni yeroo dheeraaf dhabamani turan kunneen maatii isaaniin awwaatamaa jiru.

title: US, Iran engaged in tanker war: Where is the months-long conflict headed?
english: The United States and Iran have intensified their maritime conflict by attacking each other's vessels near the strategic Strait of Hormuz. Washington targeted three Iranian oil tankers in response to Iran launching ballistic missiles at American warships. This ongoing escalation, driven by efforts to control this vital waterway, is threatening global energy supplies and reducing the likelihood of a diplomatic resolution.

title: Palestinians in Gaza bury remains of 100 people recovered from rubble
english: Families in Gaza have held funeral services for 100 Palestinians, including 60 children, whose remains were pulled from the wreckage of destroyed buildings in the Zeitoun neighborhood. These individuals were buried at al-Ma'madani cemetery after rescue teams spent weeks searching through the ruins. Authorities report that thousands of bodies remain trapped under debris, but recovery efforts are severely hampered by a critical lack of heavy machinery and protective equipment.
amharic: በጋዛ የዘይቱን ሰፈር የፈራረሱ ሕንፃዎችን በማፍረስ 60 ሕፃናትን ጨምሮ የ100 ፍልስጤማውያን አስከሬን ተገኝቶ የቀብር ሥነ ሥርዓታቸው ተፈጽሟል። የተጎጂዎቹ ቤተሰቦችና የነፍስ አድን ቡድኖች ለሳምንታት ፍለጋ ሲያደርጉ ነበር። በአሁኑ ወቅት በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ አስከሬኖች በፍርስራሽ ስር እንዳሉ የሚገመት ቢሆንም፣ አስፈላጊው ከባድ ማሽነሪዎችና የመከላከያ መሳሪያዎች ባለመኖራቸው የፍለጋ ስራው ከፍተኛ ፈተና ገጥሞታል።
oromo: Gaza keessatti namoonni 100 ta’an kanneen keessaa ijoolleen 60 ta’an, maneen diigaman keessaa baafamanii sirni awwalchaa isaanii raawwatameera. title: LIVE: Everton vs Manchester United – Premier League

title: Gaza death toll rises to 73,651 since October 2023
english: Palestinian health officials report that the total number of fatalities in Gaza has reached 73,651 since the conflict began in October 2023. Additionally, over 174,000 people have sustained injuries throughout the ongoing hostilities. Many more victims are believed to be trapped beneath destroyed buildings, making the full human toll likely much higher.
amharic: የፍልስጤም የጤና ባለስልጣናት እንደገለጹት ከጥቅምት 2023 ጀምሮ በጋዛ የተገደሉ ሰዎች ቁጥር 73,651 ደርሷል። ከዚህም በላይ በጦርነቱ ምክንያት ከ174,000 በላይ ሰዎች ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። በርካታ ሰዎች አሁንም በፍርስራሽ ስር የተቀበሩ በመሆናቸው የሟቾች ቁጥር ከዚህ በላይ ሊጨምር እንደሚችል ተገልጿል።
oromo: Hojjettoonni fayyaa Falasxiin akka ibsanitti, waraana Onkoloolessa 2023 jalqabee kaasee hanga ammaa namoonni 73,651 ta’an galaafatamaniru. Kana malees, namoonni 174,000 ol ta’an miidhaa garaagaraatiif saaxilamaniiru. Namoonni hedduun ammoo manneen diigamaniin jala akka jiran waan shakkiin jiruuf, baayyinni namoota du’anii kanaa olii ol dabaluu danda’a.

title: Iran threatens South Korean assets if Seoul joins Hormuz mission
english: An Iranian official has cautioned South Korea against joining a U.S.-led maritime coalition in the Persian Gulf. Tehran warned that such participation would lead them to view Seoul as an adversary and target their economic and military assets throughout the region. This threat extends to South Korean interests located in several neighboring countries, signaling potentially severe consequences if they align with the mission.

title: Eight foreign ministers condemn Katz and Ben Gvir’s Gaza displacement plan
english: Eight nations have jointly criticized proposals by Israeli officials to displace Palestinians from Gaza. The foreign ministers labeled these plans, which include the idea of 'voluntary emigration,' as a violation of international law. They are calling on the global community and the UN Security Council to reject any efforts to change the demographic makeup of the territory.
amharic: ስምንት ሀገራት የእስራኤል ባለስልጣናት ፍልስጤማውያንን ከጋዛ ለማፈናቀል ያቀረቡትን እቅድ በጋራ አውግዘዋል። የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትሮቹ 'ፈቃደኛ ስደት' በሚል ሽፋን የቀረበው ይህ ሃሳብ ዓለም አቀፍ ህግን የሚጥስ መሆኑን ገልጸዋል። የጋዛን ነባራዊ ሁኔታ ለመቀየር የሚደረገውን ማንኛውንም ጥረት እንዲቃወሙ ዓለም አቀፉን ማህበረሰብና የተባበሩት መንግስታት የጸጥታው ምክር ቤትን ጠይቀዋል።
oromo: Biyyoonni saddeet hoggantoonni Israa'el namoota Gaaza keessatti argaman ari'uuf karoora qopheeffatan mormaniiru. Haaluma kanaan, hawaasni idil-addunyaa fi mana maree nageenyaa dhaabbata mootummoota gamtoomanii jijjiirraa daangaa fi uummataa Gaaza keessatti godhamu mormuun akka dhaabsisan gaafataniiru.

title: Iran threatens South Korean assets if Seoul joins Hormuz mission
english: An Iranian official has warned that South Korea could face retaliatory attacks on its economic and military assets in the Middle East if it joins a US-led maritime mission in the Strait of Hormuz. While Seoul is under pressure from Washington to participate to help secure energy shipping routes, South Korean officials state that no final decision has been made. The potential involvement would require parliamentary and security council approval, as the country carefully weighs its energy security needs against the threat of Iranian hostility.

Se'ul karaa dhiibbaa Ameerikaan godhamuun akka hirmaattu barbaadamtus, hanga ammaatti murtoo dhumaa akka hin irra ga'in beeksisiteetti. Hirmaannaan kamiyyuu parlamaa fi mana maree nageenyaa biyyattii irraa hayyama kan gaafatu yoo ta'u, biyyattiin fayyadamummaa ishee kan anniisaa fi soda raadiyoo Iraan gidduutti madaala jirti.

title: Iran's response to US attacks will be 'faster, more painful', Ghalibaf says
english: Iranian Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf has warned the United States that any future aggression against Iran will face a swift and severe retaliation. He emphasized that the strategies governing their conflict have shifted and cautioned the US to acknowledge this change immediately. This statement underscores a significant hardening of Iran's position regarding its national security and regional interests.
amharic: የኢራን ፓርላማ አፈጉባኤ መሐመድ ባቅሄር ጋሊባፍ፣ አሜሪካ በኢራን ላይ ለምታደርገው ማንኛውም ጥቃት ፈጣንና ጠንካራ ምላሽ እንደምትሰጥ አስጠንቅቀዋል። በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል ያለው የጦርነት መልክ መቀየሩን የገለጹት አፈጉባኤው፣ አሜሪካ ይህንን ሁኔታ በአስቸኳይ እንድትረዳ አሳስበዋል። ይህ ማስጠንቀቂያ የኢራን መንግሥት ለብሔራዊ ደህንነቱ ያለውን አቋም ይበልጥ ማጠንከሩን ያሳያል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni mana maree biyyattii Iraan, Mohammad Baagher Gaalibaaft, yoo Ameerikaan Iraan irratti haleellaa raawwatte tarkaanfii saffisaa fi cimaa akka fudhatan akeekkachiisaniiru. Hariiroo fi haala waraana gama kanaan jiru jijjiirame akka jiru kan ibsan yoo ta'u, Ameerikaan dogoggora kana dursee hubachuu akka qabdu dhaamaniiru. Ibsi kunis mootummaan Iraan nageenya biyyattii fi faayidaa ishee eeggachuuf qophii cimaa akka jiru kan agarsiisuudha.

title: Volcano eruption triggers flight suspensions at Indonesia's main airport
english: A volcanic eruption at Indonesia’s Anak Krakatau has forced the temporary suspension of over 200 flights at Jakarta’s main airport, impacting tens of thousands of travelers. The ash plume has disrupted both domestic and international travel, while also causing health concerns for local residents due to eye and respiratory irritation. Although there is no threat of a tsunami, authorities have advised people to stay indoors and wear masks for protection.

oromo: Hujubaan kan ta'e gaarran Anaa Krakataaw, Indoneezhiyaatti dhoohuun isaa balalliiwwan 200 ol ta'an akka dhaabatan taasiseera, kunis imaltoota kumaatama hedduu miidheera. Aarri gaara kana irraa bahu imala qilleensaa gufachiisuu bira darbee, namoota naannichaa irratti miidhaa ijaa fi hargansuu geessiseera. Gufaan (tsunami) uumamuuf sodaachisuu baatus, mootummaan namootni mana keessa turuu fi of eeggannoodhaaf maskii fayyadamuu akka qaban gorseera.

title: Egyptian TV presenter sentenced to death in major drug case
english: An Egyptian court has sentenced TV presenter Sarah Khalifa and 11 others to death for their roles in a large-scale drug trafficking ring. The group was convicted of smuggling materials to manufacture synthetic narcotics and storing them in private residences. Although Khalifa pleaded her innocence, she can still appeal the verdict to a higher court.
amharic: የግብፅ ፍርድ ቤት የቴሌቪዥን አቅራቢዋን ሳራ ካሊፋን ጨምሮ 11 ግለሰቦችን በከፍተኛ ደረጃ ዕፅ በማዘዋወር ወንጀል የሞት ቅጣት ፈረደባቸው። ቡድኑ ሰው ሰራሽ ዕጾችን ለማምረት የሚያስፈልጉ ጥሬ ዕቃዎችን በድብቅ በማስገባት በግል መኖሪያ ቤቶች ውስጥ ሲያከማቹ እንደነበር ተገልጿል። የክሱ አካል የነበሩት ካሊፋ ጥፋተኛ እንዳልሆኑ ቢናገሩም፣ ውሳኔውን ለከፍተኛ ፍርድ ቤት ይግባኝ የመጠየቅ መብት አላቸው።
oromo: Mana murtii Gibxii tokko, qopheessituu TV Saaraa Khaliifaa dabalatee namoota 11 irratti yakka gurgurtaa sammuu namaa hadoochan ykn dhukkuboota sammuu irratti dhiibbaa geessisan irratti hirmaachuun du'a itti murteesse. Gareen kun qorichoota haaraa oomishuuf meeshaalee gara biyyaa galchuun mana jireenyaa keessatti qopheessaa turuun isaanii mirkanaa'eera. Khaliifaan yakka kana akka hin raawwanne dubbatus, murtee kana mana murtii ol aanaa biratti ol iyyannoo gaafachuu ni danda'u.

title: FIFA’s Infantino avoids questions on his future amid growing uncertainty
english: FIFA President Gianni Infantino has avoided addressing questions about his political future following the collapse of his controversial plan to sell World Cup rights to private investors. Facing significant pressure and potential legal challenges, he refused to confirm whether he would resign or run for re-election during an appearance at the U-20 Women’s World Cup. Tensions remain high as European football leaders continue efforts to challenge his leadership ahead of next year's election.

oromo: Pireezidaantii FIFA Jiyaanii Infaantiinoo sagantaa mirga Waancaa Addunyaa gurgurachuu karoorfatan isaan dura ture fashaluu isaa hordofee, waa'ee gara fuulduraa isaanii gaaffii dhiyaateef deebii kennuu irraa of qusatan. Tapha Waancaa Addunyaa dubartoota waggaa 20 gadii irratti kan argaman Infaantiinoo, aangoo gadhiisuu ykn filannoo itti aanu irratti dorgomuu isaanii ibsuu didaniiru. Dhiibbaa cimaa fi dhimmoota seeraa isaan mudachaa jiruun, hogganoonni kubbaa miillaa Awurooppaa filannoo dhufu irratti isaan buusuuf tattaaffii gochaa jiru.

title: UK has billions in contracts with firms tied to illegal Israeli settlements
english: A recent investigation by Al Jazeera revealed that the UK government holds approximately 2.1 billion pounds worth of public contracts with 17 companies associated with illegal Israeli settlements. This discovery contradicts the British government's stated commitment to adopting a stricter stance against these settlements in the West Bank. The findings highlight a significant discrepancy between the UK's diplomatic rhetoric and its actual business practices.

Qorannoon kun mootummaan UK buufataalee seeraan alaa kanneen naannoo Weest Baank keessatti argaman irratti tarkaanfii cimaa fudhachuu akka qabu ibsaa ture waliin wal-faallessa. Qorannoon kun ibsa diippiloomaasii UK fi hojii qabatamaa ishee gidduutti wal-dhabdee guddaa akka jiru agarsiisa.

title: Flames burst from Qantas plane engine after New Zealand takeoff
english: A Qantas flight traveling from Queenstown to Sydney experienced a scary incident when one of its engines caught fire shortly after departure. The plane was successfully diverted to Christchurch, where it managed to land without any injuries to those on board. Social media users shared footage of the engine flames as the emergency unfolded.
amharic: ከኩዊንስታውን ወደ ሲድኒ ይበር የነበረ የኳንታስ አውሮፕላን ከተነሳ ብዙም ሳይቆይ በአንደኛው ሞተሩ ላይ እሳት ተቀስቅሶ ነበር። አውሮፕላኑ በአስቸኳይ ወደ ክራይስትቸርች በማቅናት በሰላም ማረፍ ችሏል። በአውሮፕላኑ ውስጥ የነበሩ ተሳፋሪዎች ምንም አይነት ጉዳት እንዳልደረሰባቸው የተገለጸ ሲሆን የክስተቱ ምስሎች በማህበራዊ ሚዲያዎች ላይ ተሰራጭተዋል።
oromo: Xiyyaarri Qantas Queenstown irraa gara Sydney imalaa ture, erga ka'ee booda motora isaa keessaa tokko irraa ibidni boba'ee ture. title: Yemeni forces claim strategic district amid intensified Houthi clashes
english: Yemeni government forces have launched a major offensive against Houthi rebels, successfully reclaiming the strategic Hais district. This surge in fighting across Taiz and Hodeidah provinces has led to over 60 deaths, including many civilians. Government leaders maintain that these military operations are necessary to regain national control and challenge Iranian influence in the region.
amharic: የየመን የመንግስት ጦር በሁቲ አማፂያን ላይ ባደረሰው መጠነ ሰፊ ጥቃት ስትራቴጂካዊ ጠቀሜታ ያላትን የሃይስ ወረዳ መቆጣጠሩን አስታውቋል። በታይዝ እና በሆዴዳህ ግዛቶች እየተካሄደ ያለው ከፍተኛ ውጊያ ከ60 በላይ ሰዎችን ሲገድል፣ ከነዚህም መካከል በርካታ ንፁሃን ዜጎች ይገኙበታል። የመንግስት መሪዎች ይህ ወታደራዊ እርምጃ የአገሪቱን ሉዓላዊነት ለማስከበር እና የኢራንን ተፅእኖ ለመግታት አስፈላጊ መሆኑን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Humnoonni mootummaa Yaman finxaaleyyii Huutii irratti duula gaggeessaniin, aanaa Haayis kan bakka tarsiimawaa taate to'annoo isaanii jala galchaniiru. Waraanni naannoolee Taaziz fi Hodeedaah keessatti gaggeeffamaa jiru lubbuu namoota 60 ol kan galaafate yoo ta'u, isaan keessaas baay'een isaanii nagaa bulee dha. Hogganoonni mootummaa akka jedhanitti, tarkaanfiin kun biyyattii deebisanii to'achuufi dhiibbaa Iraan naannichatti qabdu hir'isuuf kan barbaachise dha.

title: Morning recap
english: Tensions have escalated significantly in the Middle East following direct naval confrontations between US and Iranian forces, including missile attacks and threats to oil shipping routes. Simultaneously, ongoing conflicts in Yemen, Lebanon, and the Gaza Strip have resulted in numerous casualties and significant military shifts. These developments have contributed to a notable decline in regional crude oil exports compared to earlier this year.
amharic: በአሜሪካ እና በኢራን የባህር ኃይል ኃይሎች መካከል በተፈጠረ ቀጥተኛ ግጭት በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ ውጥረት እየተባባሰ መጥቷል። በሌላ በኩል በየመን፣ በሊባኖስ እና በጋዛ ሰርጥ እየተካሄዱ ባሉ ግጭቶች የበርካታ ሰዎች ህይወት ማለፉና ከፍተኛ ጉዳት መድረሱ ተገልጿል። እነዚህ ክስተቶች የክልሉን የነዳጅ ዘይት ላኪነት በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ እንዲቀንስ አድርገዋል።
oromo: Giddu galeessa bahaatti waraana US fi Iran gidduutti walitti bu’iinsa bal’inaan mudateen walqabatee rakkoon nageenyaa dabaleera. Yeroo wal-fakkaatuutti, biyyoota Yaman, Libaanoos fi Gaazaatti waraanni gaggeeffamaa jiru lubbuu namoota hedduu galaafachuu fi miidhaa guddaa geessisuu isaa gabaafameera. Haalli kun oomisha boba’aa gabaa irra oolu gadi bu’uu isaa ibsameera.

title: Israeli strike kills two people in Arab Salim town of Lebanon
english: At least two individuals were killed following an Israeli airstrike on the town of Arab Salim in southern Lebanon. Prior to the attack, the Israeli military had issued a warning to local residents, identifying a specific building as a Hezbollah site and instructing people to evacuate the area. The strike occurred shortly after the military released a map highlighting the targeted zone and advised civilians to maintain a safe distance.
amharic: በደቡባዊ ሊባኖስ አረብ ሳሊም በተባለች ከተማ በእስራኤል በተፈጸመ የአየር ጥቃት ቢያንስ ሁለት ሰዎች ተገድለዋል። ጥቃቱ ከመፈጸሙ በፊት የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይል አካባቢው የሂዝቦላህ ማዕከል እንደሆነ በመግለጽ ነዋሪዎች አካባቢውን ለቀው እንዲወጡ አስጠንቅቆ ነበር። ወታደራዊው ኃይል የታቀደውን ቦታ ካርታ በማውጣት ነዋሪዎች ቢያንስ የ300 ሜትር ርቀት እንዲጠብቁ አሳስቦ ነበር።
oromo: Kibba Libaanos magaalaa Arab Saalim jedhamtu keessatti haleellaa xiyyaaraa Israa'el raawwatteen namoonni lama ajjeefamaniiru. Haleellaa kana dura, waraanni Israa'el bakki kun bakka dhaabbata Hizbullaah akka ta'e ibsuudhaan jiraattonni dafanii akka baqatan akeekkachiise ture. Waraanni Israa'el kaardii bakka haleellawuu agarsiisu gadhiisuudhaan, namoonni fageenya meetira 300 ol akka eeggatan ajajee ture.

title: Palestinian child, 50-year-old man injured in Israeli gunfire
english: Israeli military raids in the occupied West Bank resulted in injuries to a Palestinian child and a 50-year-old man. During these operations, nine people were arrested in the town of Abqaba, with additional residents reportedly held by forces. Furthermore, a vehicle owned by a Palestinian was damaged after being hit by an Israeli military vehicle in Tulkarm.
amharic: በተያዘው የዌስት ባንክ ግዛት በእስራኤል ኃይሎች በተካሄዱ ወረራዎች አንድ የፍልስጤም ህጻን እና የ50 ዓመት አዛውንት ቆስለዋል። በእነዚህ ኦፕሬሽኖች ወቅት በአብቃባ ከተማ ዘጠኝ ሰዎች ታስረዋል፤ ሌሎች ነዋሪዎችም በቁጥጥር ስር መዋላቸው ተገልጿል። በተጨማሪም በቱልካረም ከተማ በእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ተሽከርካሪ የፍልስጤም ዜጋ መኪና ላይ ግጭት ደርሷል።
oromo: Humni Israa'el naannoo Qilleensa-gadi (West Bank) keessatti tarkaanfii fudhateen ijoolleen tokko fi namni umuriin isaanii 50 ta'e miidhamaniiru. Tarkaanfii kanaan namoonni sagal magaala Abqaba keessatti hidhamaniiru, akkasumas namoonni biroo qabamanii akka jiran gabaafameera. Kana malees, magaala Tulkaarem keessatti konkolaataan kan Falistinootaa humni Israa'el konkolaataan rukutee miidheera.

title: Kites flown across 11 Dutch cities in solidarity with Gaza children
english: People in eleven Dutch cities recently held kite-flying demonstrations to show their support for children living in Gaza. Organized by a foundation, the events aimed to protest violence in the region and highlight the hardships faced by Palestinians. Participants decorated their kites with Palestinian flags and messages of peace while sharing information to raise public awareness about the ongoing crisis.
amharic: በአስራ አንድ የኔዘርላንድ ከተሞች የሚገኙ ሰዎች በጋዛ ለሚኖሩ ህጻናት ያላቸውን ድጋፍ ለመግለጽ የወረቀት ድራጎቶችን (kites) በጋራ አብረዋል። የዝግጅቱ አስተባባሪዎች ይህንን ያደረጉት በክልሉ እየተካሄደ ያለውን ጥቃት ለመቃወም እና ፍልስጤማውያን እየደረሰባቸው ያለውን ችግር ለህዝብ ለማሳወቅ ነው። ተሳታፊዎች ድራጎቶቹን በሰንደቅ ዓላማ እና በሰላም መልእክቶች በማስጌጥ ስለ ወቅታዊው ቀውስ ግንዛቤ ለመፍጠር ሞክረዋል።
oromo: Namoonni magaalota Neezarlaand kudha tokko keessa jiraatan, ijoollee Gaazaa keessa jiraniif tumsa isaanii ibsuuf jecha biyyaattii (kites) balaliisuun agarsiisa taasisaniiru. Qindeessitoonni sagantichaa tarkaanfii kana kan fudhatan, miidhaa naannichatti raawwatamaa jiru mormuuf fi rakkoo ummanni Palastayinii keessa jiru ifa baasuufi. Hirmaattotni biyyaattiiwwan isaanii alaabaa Palastayinii fi ergaawwan nagaatiin miidhagsuun, waa'ee rakkoo mudataa jiru kana irratti hubannoo uumuuf yaalaniiru.

title: Israel asks residents of Lebanon's Arab Salim to leave, warns of strike
english: The Israeli military has issued an urgent evacuation order for residents of the Arab Salim area in southern Lebanon. Officials stated that the move is a response to alleged ceasefire violations by Hezbollah, including the launch of an explosive drone. The military warned that they plan to conduct strikes against specific facilities they identify as belonging to the group.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይል በደቡብ ሊባኖስ በአረብ ሳሊም አካባቢ የሚኖሩ ነዋሪዎች አካባቢውን በአስቸኳይ ለቀው እንዲወጡ አሳስቧል። ይህ እርምጃ የተወሰደው ሂዝቦላህ ተኩስ አቁም ስምምነቱን በመጣስ ፈንጂ የጫነ ድሮን በመላኩ ምክንያት መሆኑን ባለሥልጣናቱ ገልጸዋል። የእስራኤል ጦር በቡድኑ ቁጥጥር ስር ናቸው ያላቸውን ቦታዎች ኢላማ በማድረግ ጥቃት እንደሚፈጽም አስጠንቅቋል።
oromo: Waraanni Israa'el jiraattonni magaalaa Arab Saalim kan kibba Libaanoos jiran battalumatti naannichaa gadi dhiisanii akka bahan ajajee jira. Mootummaan Israa'el tarkaanfichi kan fudhatame gareen Hizbullah waldhabdee dhaabuu irratti walii galame darbuun isaa fi xiyyaara nama hin qabne kan meeshaa waraanaa baatuu erguu isaa hordofee akka ta'e ibseera. Waraanni Israa'el iddoowwan garee kanaa ta'an irratti tarkaanfii waraanaa fudhachuuf karoorfachuu isaa akeekkachiiseera.

title: US envoys set for Ukraine talks after meeting Putin in Moscow
english: US envoys Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff held private discussions with Vladimir Putin in Moscow regarding potential plans to end the war in Ukraine. Following these meetings, the negotiators are scheduled to travel to Kyiv to consult with Ukrainian officials on the matter. As part of a move toward potential de-escalation, both Russian and Ukrainian leaders have agreed to a three-day pause on strikes targeting each other's capitals.
amharic: የአሜሪካው ልዑካን ጃሬድ ኩሽነር እና ስቲቭ ዊትኮፍ በዩክሬን ያለውን ጦርነት ለማቆም በሚያስችሉ እቅዶች ላይ ከሩሲያው ፕሬዝዳንት ቭላድሚር ፑቲን ጋር በሞስኮ ተወያይተዋል። እነዚህ ተወካዮች ከፑቲን ጋር ከተወያዩ በኋላ፣ ጉዳዩን ለመወያየት ወደ ኪየቭ እንደሚጓዙ ታውቋል። ውጥረቱን ለመቀነስ በሚያግዝ መልኩ ሩሲያ እና ዩክሬን በዋና ከተሞቻቸው ላይ ለሶስት ቀናት የድሮን እና ሚሳኤል ጥቃቶችን ለማቆም ተስማምተዋል።
oromo: Ergamtoonni Ameerikaa Jaared Kushner fi Stiiv Wiitkoof waraana Yukreenii dhaabsisuuf mala qophaa'aa jiru irratti pirezidaantii Raashiyaa Vllaadimir Puutin wajjin Moskoo keessatti mari'ataniiru. Ergamtoonni kun marii Puutin wajjin taasisaniin booda, dhimma kana irratti gorsa barbaaduuf gara Kiyiv imaluuf qophaa'aniiru. Tarkaanfii walitti bu'iinsa hir'isuuf godhameen, hoggantoonni Raashiyaa fi Yukreen magaalota gurguddoo isaanii irratti guyyoota sadiif haleellaa dhaabuuf waliigalteerra ga'aniiru.

title: TV presenter among 11 sentenced to death in Egypt drugs case
english: An Egyptian television host named Sarah Khalifa and ten others have received death sentences for their involvement in a drug trafficking ring. The group was convicted of importing materials to manufacture illegal narcotics and possessing unauthorized weapons. Although Khalifa has maintained her innocence, the court confirmed the sentence following the required approval from the grand mufti, though the decision remains subject to appeal.
amharic: የግብፅ የቴሌቪዥን አቅራቢ ሳራ ካሊፋን ጨምሮ 11 ሰዎች በአደንዛዥ ዕፅ ዝውውር ወንጀል የሞት ቅጣት ተፈረደባቸው። ቡድኑ አደንዛዥ ዕፅ ለማምረት የሚያገለግሉ ግብዓቶችን በማስገባት እና ህገ-ወጥ የጦር መሳሪያ በመያዝ ወንጀል ተከሰው ነው ጥፋተኛ የተባሉት። ካሊፋ ክሱን ብትክድም፣ ፍርድ ቤቱ የሀገሪቱን ታላቅ ሙፍቲ ፈቃድ በማግኘት ቅጣቱን አጽድቆታል፤ ሆኖም ተከሳሾቹ ውሳኔውን ይግባኝ የመጠየቅ መብት አላቸው።
oromo: Qopheessituun televizhinii Gibxii Saaraa Kaaliifaa fi namoonni biroo 10 yakka gurgurtaa qoricha sammuu namaa hadoochuun (drugs) adabbii du'aa itti murameera. Gareen kun meeshaalee qoricha sammuu namaa hadoochu ittiin oomishan seeraan alatti galchuufi meeshaalee waraanaa heyyamoota malee qabachuun himatamanii turan. Kaaliifaan yakka kana ni mormiti, ta'us mana murtichaa murtii kana erga 'Grand Mufti' Gibxii irraa heyyamni argamee booda mirkaneesseera; ta'us murtichi ol-iyyannoo itti dhiyeeffachuu kan danda'amuudha.

title: Watch: Moment 64-year-old Nepali woman is found alive in mud-buried home
english: A 64-year-old woman named Chandika Shrestha was rescued after surviving for over ten days trapped inside her home in Nepal. The house had been partially buried by a massive landslide of mud, ice, and rock. Rescuers from the Armed Police Force located her and successfully transported her by air to a hospital in Kathmandu for medical care.
amharic: ቻንዲካ ሽሬስታ የተባሉ የ64 ዓመት አዛውንት በኔፓል በጭቃ እና በበረዶ በተሸፈነ ቤታቸው ውስጥ ከዐሥር ቀናት በላይ ተይዘው ከቆዩ በኋላ በሕይወት ተገኝተዋል። የሀገሪቱ የጦር ፖሊስ አባላት በኑዋኮት ወረዳ በሚገኝ ቤታቸው ውስጥ አግኝተዋቸዋል። አዛውንቷ በአየር መንገድ ተጭነው ለህክምና ወደ ካትማንዱ ሆስፒታል ተልከዋል።
oromo: Dubartiin umrii 64 kan ta'an Chandika Shrestha jedhaman, biyya Nepaal mana isaanii cabee biyyee fi cabbii jalatti awwaalame keessatti guyyoota kudhan ol erga turanii booda lubbuun argamaniiru. Poolisiin naannichaa mana isaanii keessatti isaan argachuun, xiyyaaraan gara hospitaala Kaatmaanduutti geeffamanii yaalamaniiru.

title: ‘People laughed at me’: Indian youth cleans up a trash-filled river
english: A 21-year-old Indian student known as Bittu Tabahi successfully cleaned a polluted river on his own, despite facing mockery and safety concerns. His persistent hard work eventually turned the waterway into a cleaner space and inspired local authorities to intervene. This inspiring story highlights how individual determination can lead to significant environmental improvements.
amharic: ቢቱ ታባሂ የተባለ የ21 ዓመት ህንዳዊ ተማሪ፣ ምንም እንኳን መሳለቂያ ቢደርስበትም አንድ ትልቅ ወንዝ በብቸኝነት በማጽዳት ማሳካት ችሏል። የጽዳት ስራው ወንዙን ከብክለት በማዳን ለሌሎች አርአያ ከመሆኑም በላይ የመንግስት ትኩረት እንዲያገኝ አስችሎታል። ይህ ተግባር የአንድ ግለሰብ ቁርጠኝነት ለአካባቢ ጥበቃ ትልቅ ለውጥ እንደሚያመጣ ያሳያል።
oromo: Barataan waggaa 21 kan biyya Indiyaa Bittu Tabahi jedhamu, namoonni yoo itti kolfan illee, lagicha qofaa isaa qulqulleessuu danda'eera. Hojii isaa kanaan lagichi qulqullu ta'ee fi mootummaan akka irratti tarkaanfii fudhatu kakaasera. Gochi isaa kun murannoon namtokkee tokkoo jijjiirama guddaa naannoo irratti fiduu akka danda'u agarsiisa.

title: Netanyahu boasts about bombing Qatar, says Gaza funds used for aid
english: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu recently claimed he attacked Qatar during the Gaza conflict while dismissing criticisms regarding Qatari funds sent to the region. He stated that these financial transfers were strictly for humanitarian aid and were approved by Israel's own security services. This follows a 2025 Israeli strike on Doha that resulted in several deaths and drew widespread international condemnation for violating Qatar's sovereignty.
amharic: የእስራኤሉ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንጃሚን ኔታንያሁ በጋዛ ጦርነት ወቅት በኳታር ላይ ጥቃት እንደፈጸሙ ተናግረዋል። ወደ ጋዛ ይላኩ የነበሩት የኳታር ገንዘቦች በሰብአዊ እርዳታ ዓላማ ብቻ እንደነበሩና በእስራኤል የደህንነት ተቋማት ፈቃድ እንደተፈጸሙም ገልጸዋል። ይህ አስተያየታቸው በ2025 በዶሃ ላይ የተፈጸመውን እና ዓለም አቀፍ ቁጣን የቀሰቀሰውን የአየር ጥቃት ተከትሎ የመጣ ነው።
oromo: Mummichi ministeera Israa'el Benyaamin Netaaniyaahu waraana Gaaza keessatti Qaatar irratti haleellaa raawwachuu isaanii ibsaniiru. Maallaqni Qaatar irraa gara Gaazaatti ergamaa ture gargaarsa namoomaa qofaaf kan oolee fi tajaajila nageenyaa Israa'eliin kan mirkanaa'e ta'uu himaniiru. Ibsi kun haleellaa bara 2025 Doohaa irratti raawwatamee fi qeeqa idil-addunyaa guddaa kaase booda kan dhufe dha.

title: German company launches rocket as Europe enters satellite race
english: Germany's Isar Aerospace successfully launched its Spectrum rocket from Norway, marking the first time a privately developed rocket has reached space from European soil. The uncrewed vehicle deployed five satellites into orbit, demonstrating Europe's growing capability to launch its own technology independently. This achievement is a significant step toward reducing Europe's reliance on American providers and foreign rockets for its space missions.
amharic: የጀርመኑ ኢሳር ኤሮስፔስ ኩባንያ 'ስፔክትረም' የተሰኘውን ሮኬት ከኖርዌይ በስኬት ወደ ህዋ አስወንጭፏል። ይህም በአውሮፓ አፈር ላይ በግል ኩባንያ የተሰራ ሮኬት ወደ ህዋ ሲደርስ የመጀመሪያው ነው። ይህ ስኬት አውሮፓ በራሷ ቴክኖሎጂ ሳተላይቶችን ወደ ህዋ ለማድረስ ያላትን አቅም የሚያሳይ ሲሆን፣ በሌሎች ሀገራት ላይ የነበራትን ጥገኝነት ለመቀነስ ትልቅ እርምጃ ነው።
oromo: Dhaabbanni Jarmanii Isar Aerospace jedhamu rokkeetii 'Spectrum' jedhamu kan ofii isaa hojjete Norweey irraa gara hawaatti ergeera. Kunis rokkeetiin mataa isaa dhuunfaan hojjetame tokko biyya Awurooppaa irraa gara hawaatti yeroo jalqabaaf gahuu isaa ti. Milkaa'inni kun Awurooppaan teeknoolojii mataa isheen gara hawaatti satellite erguuf dandeettii akka qabdu kan mirkaneessu yoo ta'u, biyyoota biroo irratti hirkattummaa qabdu hir'isuuf guddina guddaa dha.

title: Iran war live: IRGC claims attacks on 3 oil tankers and 3 US-linked ships
english: Tensions in the Strait of Hormuz have escalated as Iran’s Revolutionary Guard reported attacks on three oil tankers and three vessels linked to the United States. This action follows retaliatory strikes by the US military, which successfully destroyed three Iranian crude oil tankers. The military exchange marks a significant increase in the ongoing confrontation between the two nations in this vital maritime region.
amharic: በሆርሙዝ የባህር ወሽመጥ ውስጥ በአሜሪካ እና በኢራን መካከል ያለው ውጥረት አድጓል። የኢራን እስላማዊ አብዮታዊ ዘበኛ ሦስት የነዳጅ ማመላለሻ መርከቦችን እና ከአሜሪካ ጋር ግንኙነት ያላቸውን ሦስት መርከቦች ማጥቃቱን አስታውቋል። ይህ ጥቃት የተፈጸመው አሜሪካ ሦስት የኢራን የነዳጅ መርከቦችን ካወደመች በኋላ ሲሆን፣ በሁለቱ አገራት መካከል ያለው ግጭት ከጊዜ ወደ ጊዜ እየተባባሰ መጥቷል።
oromo: Hanga'iinsa naannoo Hormuzitti jiru dabalaa dhufeera, kunis erga waraanni Irraan markaboota boba'aa sadii fi markaboota Ameerikaa waliin walitti dhufeenya qaban sadii haleellee jedhee booda kan uumamedha. Tarkaanfiin kun kan dhufe, waraanni Ameerikaa markaboota boba'aa Irraan sadii erga barbadeessee boodadha. Walitti bu'iinsi kun naannoo daldala addunyaatiif baay'ee barbaachisaa ta'e kana keessatti walitti dhufeenya biyyoota lamaanii caalaatti hammaachisuu isaa argisiisa.

title: IRGC claims American Unmanned Surface Vessel struck in Hormuz
english: The Iranian Revolutionary Guard Corps reported that it intercepted and hit an American unmanned surface vessel in the Strait of Hormuz. Iranian officials claimed the vessel was attempting to enter restricted waters and warned the United States to withdraw from the area. This incident underscores rising tensions as Iran asserts control over the strategic maritime route.
amharic: የኢራን እስላማዊ አብዮታዊ ዘበኞች ኃይል በሆርሙዝ ባህር ወሽመጥ ውስጥ የአሜሪካን ሰው አልባ የባህር ላይ መርከብ መምታቱን አስታውቋል። ኢራን መርከቧ የተከለከለውን የባህር ክልል ለመጣስ ሙከራ ማድረጓን በመጥቀስ፣ አሜሪካ ከክልሉ እንድትወጣ ማስጠንቀቂያ ሰጥታለች። ይህ ክስተት በኢራን እና በአሜሪካ መካከል ያለውን ውጥረት ይበልጥ ያባባሰው ይመስላል።
oromo: Humnoonni Eegumsa Gamtaa Islaamaa Iraan, doonii Amerikaa kan namni irra hin jirree fi bishaan keessa deemu tokko Hormuz keessatti rukutuu isaanii ibsaniiru. Iraan, dooniin tun naannoo dhoorkaa ta'e seenuuf yaalii waan gooteef akka rukutame ibsitee, Amerikaan naannoo sana akka gadi lakkistu akeekkachiisteetti. Ta'umsi kun walitti bu'iinsa biyyoota lamaan gidduu jiru kan hammeesse dha.

title: Gaza death toll since October 2023 rises to 73,651, health ministry says
english: The Gaza health ministry reports that the total death toll from the ongoing conflict has reached 73,651 since October 2023, with over 174,000 people injured. Recent recovery efforts have retrieved several bodies from rubble and documented new fatalities, despite ongoing challenges for rescue teams to reach isolated areas. Authorities also confirmed that hundreds of additional deaths were recorded following recent verification efforts.
amharic: የጋዛ ጤና ሚኒስቴር እንደገለጸው፣ ከጥቅምት 2023 ጀምሮ በጋዛ በተካሄደው ግጭት የሟቾች ቁጥር 73,651 ደርሷል፤ ከ174,000 በላይ ሰዎች ደግሞ ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። የነፍስ አድን ቡድኖች በተበላሹ ህንጻዎች ስር የነበሩ አስከሬኖችን ማውጣታቸውን የቀጠሉ ሲሆን፣ በቅርቡ በተደረገ ማጣራት ተጨማሪ የሟቾች ቁጥር ተመዝግቧል። የነፍስ አድን ሰራተኞች በየቦታው በተበተኑ ፍርስራሾች እና መንገዶች ላይ ያሉ ተጎጂዎችን ለመድረስ ከፍተኛ ችግር እየገጠማቸው ይገኛል።
oromo: Ministeerri Fayyaa Gaaza akka gabaasetti, waraana Onkoloolessa 2023 jalqabee kaasee lubbuun namoota 73,651 darbeera, namoonni 174,000 ol ta'anis miidhamaniiru. Gareewwan fayyisummaa diiggaa keessatti reeffa namoota baasuu itti fufanii jiran, akkasumas qulqulleeffannaa booda du'aatii dabalataa galmeessaniiru. Gareewwan kun lafa diiggaa fi daandiiwwan irratti namoota hafan bira gahuuf rakkoo guddaa keessa akka jiran ibsameera.

title: Two protesters detained during pro-Palestine demonstration in Berlin
english: German police arrested at least two individuals during a pro-Palestinian rally in Berlin on Saturday. A large crowd gathered at Ernst Reuter Square to express opposition to Israel's military actions in Gaza. Authorities intervened to manage the demonstration, resulting in the detention of several participants.
amharic: ቅዳሜ ዕለት በበርሊን በተካሄደ የፍልስጤም ደጋፊዎች ሰልፍ ላይ የጀርመን ፖሊስ ቢያንስ ሁለት ሰዎችን በቁጥጥር ስር አውሏል። በኤርነስት ሮይተር አደባባይ የተሰበሰቡ በርካታ ተቃዋሚዎች እስራኤል በጋዛ የምታደርገውን ወታደራዊ ጥቃት ተቃውመዋል። ሰልፉን ለመቆጣጠር በፖሊስ በተወሰደው እርምጃም የተወሰኑ ተሳታፊዎች ታስረዋል።
oromo: Dilbata darbe magaalaa Berlinitti hiriira deggarsa Falasxiin taasifame irratti poolisiin Jarmanii namoota lama caalan to’annoo jala oolchaniiru. Hiriirtonni hedduun bakka Ernst Reuter Square jedhamutti walga’uun, tarkaanfii waraana Israa’el gama Gazaan fudhatamaa jiru mormaniiru. Poolisiin hiriiricha to’achuuf tarkaanfii fudhateenis namoonni tokko tokko qabamaniiru.

title: Netanyahu dismisses 'all this controversy' around Qatar as 'big hoax'
english: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has rejected recent criticism regarding his relationship with Qatar, labeling the controversy a fabrication. He defended his record by noting that he has engaged in military confrontations with the nation. Furthermore, he insisted that while he views Qatar as a hostile entity, it has not successfully exerted any influence over Israeli decision-making.
amharic: የእስራኤሉ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ ከኳታር ጋር ስላላቸው ግንኙነት የሚነሱ ትችቶችን ውድቅ በማድረግ ውዝግቡን የፈጠራ ወሬ ሲሉ ገልጸውታል። ኔታንያሁ በጦርነቱ ወቅት በሀገሪቱ ላይ ወታደራዊ ጥቃት እንደፈጸሙ በመግለጽ የራሳቸውን አቋም ተከላክለዋል። በተጨማሪም ኳታር ጠላት ብትሆንም በእስራኤል ውሳኔዎች ላይ ምንም አይነት ተጽዕኖ መፍጠር እንዳልቻለች አስረግጠው ተናግረዋል።
oromo: Mummichi ministeera Israa'el Benyamin Netanyaahuun walitti dhufeenya isaan biyya Kaataar wajjin qabanirratti komii dhiyaate dhugaa hin qabu jechuun waakkatan. Netanyaahuun yeroo waraanaatti biyyattii irratti tarkaanfii waraanaa fudhachuu isaanii ibsuun himata kana haalaniiru. Akkasumas, Kaataar diina taatus murtoo Israa'el irratti dhiibbaa geessisuu akka hin dandeenye ibsaniiru.

title: Centcom says Iranian oil tanker has sunk in Gulf of Oman
english: The U.S. Central Command confirmed that an Iranian oil tanker named M/T Kylo has sunk in the Gulf of Oman. This action was taken by American forces in retaliation for Iranian missile attacks on U.S. warships earlier in the week. Video footage shared by Centcom shows the vessel on fire before it submerged.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ሴንትኮም ኤም/ቲ ካይሎ የተባለ የኢራን ነዳጅ ጫኝ መርከብ በኦማን ባህረ ሰላጤ መስጠሙን አስታውቋል። ይህ እርምጃ የተወሰደው በሳምንቱ መጀመሪያ ላይ በኢራን ሚሳኤል ለተሰነዘረባቸው የአሜሪካ የጦር መርከቦች አጸፋ ለመስጠት ነው። ሴንትኮም ይፋ ባደረገው የቪዲዮ ምስል መርከቧ በእሳት ተያይዛ ስትሰጥም ይታያል።
oromo: Ajajni giddu galeessa Ameerikaa (Centcom) doonii boba'aa kan Iraan kan maqaan ishee M/T Kylo jedhamu galaana Omaann keessatti akka liqimfatte mirkaneesseera. Tarkaanfiin kun kan fudhatame dooniiwwan waraanaa Ameerikaa irratti haleellaa rokketii Iraan raawwatteef haaloo ba'uufi. Viidiyoon Centcom gadi dhiise dooniin sun ibiddaan gubachaa osoo jirtu gara jalaatti yommuu liqimfamtu argisiisa.

title: SINGER WHO WANTS TO GIVE THE OLD SONGS AN ORCHESTRA
english: Singer Aschalew Fetene, famously known as Ardi, is dedicated to revitalizing classic Ethiopian music by arranging it for orchestral performances. Known for his profound poetic lyrics, he is working to give traditional songs a fresh and grand musical identity. His artistic project aims to preserve the depth of older music while modernizing its presentation through sophisticated instrumentation.
amharic: አርዲ በሚል ስም የሚታወቀው ድምጻዊ አሸለፍ ፈተነ፣ የቆዩ የኢትዮጵያ ሙዚቃዎችን በኦርኬስትራ በማጀብ አዲስ መልክ ለማስተዋወቅ እየሰራ ነው። በግጥሞቹ ጥልቀት የሚታወቀው አርቲስቱ፣ የቀድሞ ዘፈኖችን በዘመናዊ የሙዚቃ መሳሪያዎች በማቀናበር ለታዳሚው ለማቅረብ ጥረት እያደረገ ይገኛል። ይህ የፈጠራ ስራው ጥንታዊ የሙዚቃ ቅርስን ከዘመናዊ አቀራረብ ጋር በማዋሃድ ለማቆየት ያለመ ነው።
oromo: Weellisaan Ardi jedhamee beekamu Aschalew Feten, faaruuwwan durii guddisee fi orkestraan akka dhihaatan gochuun beekama. Geerarsa isaa keessatti hiika qabatamaa fi ogummaa walaloo guddaa kan qabu artistichi, muuziqaa durii ibsa haaraa fi miira ammayyaa keessatti mul'isuuf tattaaffii godhaa jira. Hojiin isaa kun muuziqaan durii kun akka hin dagatamne fi dhaloota haaraaf akka ta'utti qophii adda ta'e godhaafii jira.

title: Priced Out of the Holiday
english: Furniture prices in Addis Ababa have surged by up to 54 percent over the past year, significantly reducing consumer purchasing power ahead of the New Year. Although showrooms remain busy with visitors, most people are choosing to forgo large purchases or are opting for cheaper alternatives like paint instead of new furniture. Consequently, the traditional holiday shopping rush has slowed down to a minimum.
amharic: ባለፈው ዓመት በአዲስ አበባ የቤት ዕቃዎች ዋጋ እስከ 54 በመቶ ጭማሪ በማሳየቱ የህዝቡ የመግዛት አቅም በእጅጉ ቀንሷል። በአዲሱ ዓመት በዓል ዋዜማ የቤት ዕቃ መሸጫ ቤቶች ጎብኚዎች ቢኖሩም፣ አብዛኛዎቹ ሸማቾች ውድ የቤት ዕቃዎችን ከመግዛት ይልቅ ጥገናን ወይም አነስተኛ ወጪ የሚጠይቁ ነገሮችን መግዛትን መርጠዋል። በዚህም ምክንያት፣ በበዓላት ወቅት የሚታየው የተለመደው የገበያ እንቅስቃሴ በእጅጉ ተዳክሟል።
oromo: Gatiin meeshaalee manaa magaalaa Finfinnee keessatti waggaa darbe keessa harka 54 hanga dabaluun, dandeettiin bituu uummataa daran hir'ateera. Yeroo ayyaana waggaa haaraa kana, manneen gurgurtaa meeshaalee manaa namoonni daawwatuus, hedduun isaanii meeshaalee gatii guddaa qaban bituu irra deebi'anii fayyadamuu ykn dibata mana bittuu filachaa jiru. Kanaan kan ka'es, sochii gurgurtaa ayyaanotaa kan duraan baramee ture daran hir'ateera.

title: Ethio telecom Promises First Payout to Shareholders
english: Ethio telecom is preparing to offer dividends to its over 47,000 shareholders for the first time since the company opened for private investment two years ago. The company achieved a strong financial performance last year, recording over 215 billion Birr in revenue and significant gross profits. Shareholders will soon learn at the General Assembly whether they will receive their payouts in cash or as additional company shares.
amharic: ኢትዮ ቴሌኮም ከሁለት ዓመት በፊት ድርሻቸውን ለገዙ ከ47 ሺህ በላይ ባለአክሲዮኖች ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ የትርፍ ድርሻ ክፍያ ለመፈጸም ዝግጅት እያደረገ ነው። ኩባንያው ባለፈው ዓመት ከ215 ቢሊዮን ብር በላይ ገቢ እና ከፍተኛ ትርፍ በማስመዝገብ አበረታች አፈጻጸም አሳይቷል። ባለአክሲዮኖች ክፍያቸውን በጥሬ ገንዘብ ወይስ በአክሲዮን መልክ እንደሚያገኙ በጠቅላላ ጉባኤያቸው ይወሰናል።
oromo: Ethio telecom waggoota lama dura qooda fudhattoota isaa ta'aniif yeroo jalqabaatiif qooda bu'aa kaffaluuf qophaa'aa jira. Dhaabbatichi waggaa darbe galii biiliyoona 215 ol argachuudhaan bu'aa guddaa galmeesseera. Qooda fudhattoonni kaffaltii kana maallaqaan ykn qooda dabalataadhaan akka argatan walgahii waliigalaatiin kan murtaa'u ta'a.

title: Dispute Over Signatures Put Savor Addis in Paralysis
english: The Savor Addis restaurant is facing a financial crisis because its two co-owners, who are divorced, refuse to sign checks together. This disagreement prevents the business from paying its 157 employees, suppliers, and tax obligations. Despite the restaurant having plenty of customers, the legal deadlock between the owners has forced the business into paralysis.
amharic: ሳቮር አዲስ የተሰኘው ምግብ ቤት በሁለቱ ባለቤቶቹ መካከል በተፈጠረ አለመግባባት ምክንያት ከፍተኛ የገንዘብ ቀውስ ውስጥ ገብቷል። የተፋቱት ባለቤቶች ቼክ ለመፈራረም ፈቃደኛ ባለመሆናቸው ምግብ ቤቱ ለ157 ሰራተኞቹ ደመወዝ፣ ለዕቃ አቅራቢዎች ክፍያ እና ለግብር ባለስልጣን የሚገባውን ግብር መክፈል አልቻለም። በቂ ደንበኞች ቢኖሩትም፣ በባለቤቶቹ መካከል ያለው የህግ ክርክር እና የፊርማ አለመግባባት ተቋሙን ለአገልግሎት ማቆም ዳርጎታል።
oromo: Mana nyaataa Savor Addis jedhamu, abbootii qabeenyaa lama kan wal hiikan gidduutti wal dhabdee mudateen rakkoo maallaqaa keessa galeera. Abbootiin qabeenyaa kun waliin mallatteessuu waan didaniif, dhaabbatichi hojjattoota 157, dhiyeessitoota fi gibira mootummaa kafaluu dadhabeera. Maamiltoonni hedduu jiraatanis, wal dhabdee seeraa fi mallattoo gidduu isaanii jiruun wal qabatee hojiin dhaabbatichaa guutummaatti dhaabbachuuf ga’eera.

title: New Standard Seeks to Measure Projects Actually Built
english: The Ethiopian Construction Authority has introduced a new standard to accurately assess the physical progress of construction projects. This initiative aims to address the discrepancy between financial payments made and the actual work completed on-site. By focusing on physical benchmarks rather than spending, the authority hopes to curb significant cost overruns that frequently plague major infrastructure developments.
amharic: የኢትዮጵያ ኮንስትራክሽን ባለስልጣን የኮንስትራክሽን ፕሮጀክቶችን ትክክለኛ የሥራ አፈጻጸም ለመለካት የሚያስችል አዲስ መመሪያ አስተዋውቋል። ይህ አሰራር ለፕሮጀክቶች ከሚወጣው የገንዘብ ክፍያ ይልቅ በቦታው ላይ የተከናወነውን ትክክለኛ የግንባታ ሥራ መሠረት ያደረገ ነው። ይህንን አዲስ መለኪያ በመጠቀም በብዙ የኢንፍራስትራክቸር ግንባታዎች ላይ የሚስተዋለውን ከመጠን ያለፈ የወጪ መጨመር ለመቆጣጠር ታቅዷል።
oromo: Abbaan taayitaa ijaarsa biyyaalessaa hojiiwwan ijaarsaa hangam akka ga'an sirriitti safaruuf sadarkaa haaraa diriirseera. Tarkaanfii kana kan fudhate, maallaqa kaffalameefii fi hojii lafa irratti raawwatame gidduutti garaagarummaan guddaan akka jiraatu hubachuun booda dha. Hojichi baasii maallaqaarratti osoo hin ta'in, hojii ijaarsaa lafa irratti raawwatame irratti xiyyeeffachuun, baasii qisaasa'aa ta'e kan proojektota ijaarsaa irratti mul'atu hir'isuuf kaayyeeffateera.

title: Fuel tanker blast in western Iran kills at least 10
english: A fuel tanker explosion on a highway in western Iran has resulted in the deaths of at least 10 people. The accident was reportedly triggered by a brake malfunction on the vehicle while traveling on the Hamedan-Sanandaj road. Additionally, six other individuals sustained injuries, highlighting ongoing concerns regarding road safety and aging transport infrastructure in the country.
amharic: በምዕራብ ኢራን በሚገኝ አውራ ጎዳና ላይ የነዳጅ ማመላለሻ ተሽከርካሪ በመፈንዳቱ ቢያንስ 10 ሰዎች ሕይወታቸው አልፏል። አደጋው የደረሰው ተሽከርካሪው በሃመዳን-ሳናንዳጅ መንገድ ላይ ሲጓዝ የብሬክ ብልሽት በማጋጠሙ ነው። በተጨማሪም ሌሎች ስድስት ሰዎች ጉዳት የደረሰባቸው ሲሆን፣ ይህ አደጋ በአገሪቱ ውስጥ ያለው የመንገድ ደህንነት እና የትራንስፖርት ተሽከርካሪዎች ብልሽት አሳሳቢ መሆኑን የሚያሳይ ነው።
oromo: Iraan dhihaa keessatti konkolaataan boba'aa fe'u tokko karaa gurguddaa irratti odoo deemuufi utuu hin oolin hoomaa (explosion) mudateen namoonni 10 yoo du'an, kaan immoo miidhamaniiru. Balaan kun kan uumame konkolaatichaan furree (brake) irratti rakkoo mudateen karaa Hamadan-Sanandaj irratti ta'uu gabaafameera. Balaan kun rakkoo nageenya karaa fi meeshaalee geejjibaa dullomoo biyyattii keessa jiru irraa kan ka'e kan uumame yoo ta'u, namoonni ja'a immoo madaa'aniiru.

title: Trump-backed group announces $10m ad spend for midterm Senate race in Texas
english: A pro-Trump political group called MAGA, Inc. is launching a $10 million advertising campaign in Texas to support Republican Ken Paxton in his Senate race. The ads aim to discredit his Democratic opponent, James Talarico, by focusing on tax policies and labeling his views as too extreme for the state. This significant investment highlights the high stakes of the midterm elections, as Democrats look to win a Texas Senate seat for the first time in over thirty years.
amharic: ዶናልድ ትራምፕን የሚደግፈው ማጋ ኢንክ (MAGA, Inc) የተባለ ቡድን በቴክሳስ የሴኔት ምርጫ ሪፐብሊካኑን ኬን ፓክስትን ለመርዳት የ10 ሚሊዮን ዶላር የማስታወቂያ ዘመቻ መጀመሩን አስታውቋል። ማስታወቂያዎቹ የዴሞክራቱን ተወዳዳሪ ጄምስ ታላሪኮን የግብር ፖሊሲ በመተቸት እና አመለካከታቸው ለግዛቲቱ ተገቢ እንዳልሆነ በመግለጽ ለማሸነፍ ያለመ ነው። ይህ ከፍተኛ ወጪ፣ ዴሞክራቶች ከሰላሳ ዓመታት በላይ ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ በቴክሳስ የሴኔት መቀመጫ ለማግኘት በሚያደርጉት ከፍተኛ ፉክክር ውስጥ የተደረገ ነው።
oromo: Gareen Donald Trump deeggaru kan MAGA, Inc jedhamu, filannoo Senetii Texas keessatti namoota Republican Ken Paxton deggeruuf dursanii $10 miiliyoonaa beeksisarratti baasuuf murteessaniiru. Beeksisichi morkataa isaanii kan Democratic James Talarico irratti kan xiyyeeffatu yoo ta'u, imaammata gibiraa isaanii irratti komii kaasuun akkasumas yaada isaanii kan akka malee oolu (radical) jechuun maqaa balleessuuf yaalii godha. Baasni kun filannoo giddu-galeessaa kana keessatti guddina qaba, sababni isaas gareen Democrats waggoota soddoma ol booda Texas keessatti injifachuuf carraa qabaachuun isaaniiti.

title: Fresh Yemen clashes kill more than 60, including 26 soldiers
english: Heavy fighting between Yemeni government forces and Houthi rebels in the country's southwest has resulted in over 60 deaths, including 26 soldiers and several civilians. The clashes escalated following the failure of a previous ceasefire, as Houthi forces attempt to gain control over strategic areas near the Red Sea. Both sides reported significant casualties, and the violence remains intense as the government deploys reinforcements to defend key locations.
amharic: በየመን መንግስት እና በሁቲ አማፂያን መካከል በተነሳው ከፍተኛ ውጊያ ከ60 በላይ ሰዎች መሞታቸውን ምንጮች አስታውቀዋል። ከሞቱት መካከል 26 ወታደሮች እና በርካታ ሲቪሎች ይገኙበታል። ሁቲዎች ቀይ ባህርን የሚቆጣጠሩ ስልታዊ ቦታዎችን ለመያዝ የሚያደርጉት ጥረት ከሰላም ስምምነቱ መፍረስ በኋላ የከፋ ግጭት አስከትሏል። መንግስት አካባቢውን ለመከላከል ተጨማሪ ወታደሮችን ወደ ስፍራው እየላከ ይገኛል።
oromo: Mootummaa Yamanifi finxaaleyyii Huutii gidduutti waraana dhiheenya kana ka'een namoonni 60 ol lubbuun isaanii darbeera; isaan keessaa 26 waraana mootummaa fi warra nagaati. Waraanichi kan hammaate guyyoota muraasa dura walii galteen nagaa erga diigamee booda, gareen Huutii lafa tarsiimawaa galaana diimaa waliin walqabatu to'achuuf yaaluun isaa waldhabdee kana daran hammaachiiseera. Mootummaan naannoo sana ittisuuf humna dabalataa gara dirree waraanaatti ergaa jira.

title: IRGC claims US aircraft carrier, destroyer forced to flee after missile attacks
english: The Iranian Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) claims to have targeted a US aircraft carrier and a destroyer with ballistic missiles. Iran alleges these warships were obstructing its vessels and maintaining a naval blockade. According to Iranian officials, the American ships suffered damage and retreated from the area to avoid additional strikes.
amharic: የኢራኑ እስላማዊ አብዮታዊ ዘበኛ ኃይል በሁለት የአሜሪካ የጦር መርከቦች ላይ በባለስቲክ ሚሳይሎች ጥቃት ማድረሱን አስታውቋል። ኢራን መርከቦቹ የሀገሪቱን መርከቦች ሲያውኩ እንደነበርና የባህር ላይ እገዳ ጥለው እንደነበር ትከሳለች። በኢራን በኩል እንደተገለጸው የአሜሪካ መርከቦች በደረሰባቸው ጉዳት እና ተጨማሪ ጥቃትን በመፍራት አካባቢውን ለቀው እንዲወጡ ተገደዋል።

title: UKMTO says several vessels subjected to 'disabling fire' in Arabian Gulf, Gulf of Oman
english: Several merchant ships in the Arabian Gulf and the Gulf of Oman have been hit by disabling fire due to rising military tensions in the area. Authorities have not yet confirmed if there are any injuries or pollution resulting from these attacks. Mariners are being urged to stay extremely cautious and monitor the latest security updates closely.
amharic: በአረብ ባህር እና በኦማን ባህር ሰላማዊ የንግድ መርከቦች ላይ ወታደራዊ ግጭቶችን ተከትሎ ጥቃት ደርሷል። ባለሥልጣናት በደረሰው ጥቃት የሰው ህይወት መጥፋቱን ወይም የአካባቢ ብክለት መፈጠሩን እስካሁን አላረጋገጡም። መርከበኞች የደህንነት ሁኔታውን በጥንቃቄ እንዲከታተሉ እና አስፈላጊውን ጥንቃቄ እንዲያደርጉ ተመክሯል።
oromo: Naannoo Ganda Arabaa fi Ganda Omaanitti, walitti bu’iinsa waraanaa jirun walqabatee dooniiwwan daldalaa hedduun miidhamaniiru. Aangeyyoonni miidhaan lubbuu ykn faalamni naannoo hanga ammaatti akka hin mirkanaa’in ibsaniiru. Namoonni doonii oofan haala nageenyaa jiru hordofanii of eeggannoo cimaa akka taasisan gorfamaniiru.

title: Prince William to attend King Harald's funeral in Norway
english: Prince William will travel to Oslo next Wednesday to represent King Charles at the funeral of Norway’s late King Harald V. He will be joined by Princess Anne to honor the 89-year-old monarch, who was widely respected for his modern and humble approach to leadership. The burial ceremony follows a period of national mourning for the king, who ruled for 35 years.
amharic: ልዑል ዊሊያም በኖርዌይ የሟቹ ንጉስ ሃራልድ አምስተኛ የቀብር ስነ-ስርዓት ላይ ንጉስ ቻርለስን በመወከል በሚቀጥለው ረቡዕ ኦስሎ ይገኛሉ። ከ89 አመት እድሜ በኋላ ያረፉት ንጉስ ሃራልድ፣ ለዘመናዊ እና ትሁት የአመራር ዘይቤያቸው በሰፊው ይከበሩ ነበር። ልዕልት አን እንዲሁ በቀብር ስነ-ስርዓቱ ላይ የሚገኙ ሲሆን፣ ህዝቡም ለ35 አመታት ሀገሪቱን የመሩትን ንጉስ የመጨረሻ ክብር እየሰጠ ይገኛል።
oromo: Ilmi mootii Wiiliyam guyyaa Roobii dhufu magaala Oslo deemuun, awwaalcha mootii Norwey kan ta’an Haraldi V irratti abbaa isaanii mootii Chaarlis bakka bu’u. Mootiin umriin isaanii waggaa 89 ta’e kun, hogganummaa ammayyaawaafi gad-aantummaa isaaniitiin kan beekaman yoo ta’u, biyyattii waggaa 35f bulchaniiru. Awwaalcha kana irratti ilmi mootii Wiiliyam waliin kan argaman liiqii Anne yoo ta’u, ummanni biyyattis mootii isaanii kanaaf kabaja dhumaa laatachaa jiru.

title: Building collapses after heavy rain in northern India
english: A multi-story building in Muradabad, India, collapsed following days of intense rainfall. Fortunately, no injuries occurred because the structure had been emptied after residents noticed cracks forming in the walls. The collapse also damaged local power lines, causing electrical sparks in the area.

oromo: Indiyaa magaalaa Muradabaaditti guyyoota hedduuf rooba cimaa roobeen walqabatee, gamoon gurguddaan tokko diigameera. Diigamuu gamoo kanaanis hangaawwan elektirikii miidhamuun, bakka sana cinaatti ibiddi akka dhoohu ta'eera.

title: Balkans: Israel deepens ties with Bosnian Serb separatists through Banja Luka trade office
english: Israel has opened a new Chamber of Commerce office in Banja Luka, deepening its political and economic ties with the Serb-led entity of Republika Srpska. This move is seen as part of a broader strategy by Israel to build alliances with separatist movements, despite the entity's controversial push to undermine Bosnian unity. High-ranking Israeli officials attended the ceremony, further strengthening their relationship with nationalist leader Milorad Dodik, who has been a vocal supporter of Israeli policies.
amharic: እስራኤል በባንጃ ሉካ አዲስ የንግድ ምክር ቤት ቢሮ በመክፈት ከሪፐብሊካ ስርፕስካ የሰርብ ታጣቂዎች ጋር ያላትን የፖለቲካ እና የኢኮኖሚ ግንኙነት አጠናክራለች። ይህ እርምጃ እስራኤል የቦስኒያን አንድነት አደጋ ላይ ከሚጥሉ ተገንጣይ ቡድኖች ጋር የጠበቀ ግንኙነት ለመፍጠር የምታደርገው ጥረት አካል ተደርጎ ተወስዷል። በምረቃው ስነስርዓት ላይ ከፍተኛ የእስራኤል ባለስልጣናት የተገኙ ሲሆን፣ የቦስኒያን አንድነት በሚያዳክመው መሪ ሚሎራድ ዶዲክ እና በእስራኤል መካከል ያለው ወዳጅነት ይበልጥ ተጠናክሯል።
oromo: Israa'el gamoo mana maree daldalaa haaraa magaalaa Banja Luukaa keessatti banuun, hariiroo siyaas-dinagdee isheen mootummaa Republika Srpska wajjin qabdu caalaatti jabeessiteerti. title: Why is Argentina reigniting the Falklands dispute?
english: Argentina has reopened its long-standing territorial dispute with the United Kingdom over the Falkland Islands. President Javier Milei is challenging a British-Israeli oil exploration project near the islands and has threatened to impose sanctions on participating companies. Tensions have further increased due to comments from Donald Trump regarding a possible shift in the US position on the territory, raising concerns about the future of the islands.
amharic: አርጀንቲና በፎክላንድ ደሴቶች ላይ ከእንግሊዝ ጋር የነበራትን የረጅም ጊዜ የወሰን ክርክር እንደገና አነሳሳች። ፕሬዚዳንት ሀቪየር ሚሌይ በደሴቶቹ አቅራቢያ የሚካሄደውን የነዳጅ ፍለጋ ፕሮጀክት በመቃወም በኩባንያዎቹ ላይ ማዕቀብ እንደሚጥሉ አስፈራርተዋል። ከዚህም በተጨማሪ ዶናልድ ትራምፕ የአሜሪካን አቋም እንደገና ሊያስቡበት እንደሚችሉ የሰጡት አስተያየት በጉዳዩ ላይ ያለውን ውጥረት አባብሶታል።
oromo: Arjantiinaan gaaffii daangaa ganda Falkland irratti biyya Ingilizii wajjin qabdu ammas kaasiteetti.
